aCNRSLSCI.meaning: China Retail Sales: Retail Sales, By Area, City. Retail-sector statistic — sub-category, regional, or alternative aggregation.

aCNRSLS.how_to_use: Use YoY (aCNRSLAR) for trend. Level useful for analytical baseline. Retail sales are a narrower measure than US-style retail since they exclude services.

aCNRSLAR.description: Retail Sales, Consumer goods, Chg Y/Y, National Bureau of Statistics of China
aCNRSLAR.meaning: Retail Sales of Consumer Goods, year-over-year change — headline retail print released monthly by NBS ~15th of each month with the broad activity bundle.
aCNRSLAR.how_to_use: THE China consumer-spending gauge. Pre-2018 ~9-10% YoY; post-COVID ~3-5% (sustained sub-5% reflects consumption weakness). Sub-3% YoY is recession-territory. Pair with consumer confidence (aCNCONCF) and online retail sales (aCNRSONLNR).

aCNCEXTYA.description: Total External Debt, % year on year, Standardized, Chg Y/Y
aCNCEXTYA.meaning: Total External Debt, YoY change — pace of external-debt accumulation.
aCNCEXTYA.how_to_use: Track for external-vulnerability buildup. China's external debt growth slowed sharply post-2022 with USD strength + capital-control tightening. Watch alongside FDI for net foreign claims direction.

aCNCEXTA.meaning: Total External Debt — debt owed to non-residents (FX + RMB-denominated debt held by foreigners). ~$2.5 trillion (2024). Published quarterly by SAFE.
aCNCEXTA.how_to_use: China external debt is moderate at ~14% of GDP (vs 30% for India, 50%+ for many EM peers). Composition: ~60% short-term (mostly trade credits + interbank), ~40% long-term (sovereign + corporate bonds). Foreign holdings of CGBs are ~$200 billion.

aCHGOVBALA.meaning: China Government Finance: Central Government Balance. Fiscal aggregate or sub-aggregate from MoF.
aCHGOVBALA.how_to_use: Track for fiscal-stance signals. China's official deficit (~3% of GDP) understates true fiscal stance — augmented deficit (including LGFVs, special bonds) typically 8-12% of GDP. Watch government fund revenue separately for land-sale revenue impact.

aCNCGEXP.meaning: General Government Expenditure (Budgetary) — central + local government spending. Major lines: education, social security, healthcare, infrastructure, defense, agriculture support, public administration.
aCNCGEXP.how_to_use: Pro-cyclical fiscal stance shifted to counter-cyclical 2018+. Watch the 'special-purpose bond quota' set in March each year — this drives infrastructure spending. Front-loading bond issuance to Q1-Q2 signals counter-cyclical fiscal push.

aCNGGREVG.meaning: General Government Revenue, YoY — pace of revenue growth.
aCNGGREVG.how_to_use: Cyclical with GDP. Watch land-sales-revenue separately reported by MoF — its YoY changes far more cyclical than total revenue.

aCNGDEF.meaning: General Government Deficit/Surplus — China's official budget balance. Released monthly by the Ministry of Finance.
aCNGDEF.how_to_use: Official deficit understates true fiscal stance — excludes local-government financing vehicles (LGFVs), special bonds, and other off-budget items. Augmented fiscal deficit (IMF measure) typically 8-12% of GDP vs official ~3%. Watch the official-vs-augmented gap.

aCNCGREV.meaning: General Government Revenue — central + local tax + non-tax receipts. Major sources: VAT (~40%), corporate income tax (~25%), individual income tax (~7%), customs (~3%), state-owned-enterprise dividends (~7%).
aCNCGREV.how_to_use: Tax-to-GDP ~16% — moderate. Land sales (counted separately as 'government fund revenue', ~CNY 8 trillion historical peak) are critical to local-government finances; collapsed 2022-24 with property downturn — major fiscal stress point.

aCNCGOVA.meaning: Central Government Deficit/Surplus (Standardized) — central-only fiscal balance (excludes local governments). The 'on-budget' deficit subject to the 3%-of-GDP cap.
aCNCGOVA.how_to_use: Used in central-government budget arithmetic. Local-government deficits run ~4-6% of GDP separately, financed via LGFV bonds and special-purpose bonds. The total 'general government' framework is the meaningful sustainability measure.

aCNCGOVPA.description: Central government Deficit/Surplus, month on month, Standardized, Absolute change
aCNCGOVPA.meaning: China Government Finance: Central government Deficit/Surplus, month on month, Standardized, Absolute change. Fiscal aggregate or sub-aggregate from MoF.
aCNCGOVPA.how_to_use: Track for fiscal-stance signals. China's official deficit (~3% of GDP) understates true fiscal stance — augmented deficit (including LGFVs, special bonds) typically 8-12% of GDP. Watch government fund revenue separately for land-sale revenue impact.

aCNPDEBTA.meaning: Central Government Debt, Total — outstanding central-government debt. About CNY 40 trillion (2024). Excludes local-government debt (~CNY 90 trillion in special + general bonds plus implicit LGFV debt).
aCNPDEBTA.how_to_use: Central-government debt-to-GDP ~30% (low by international standards). Total public debt including local + LGFVs ~85-90% of GDP (closer to advanced-economy norms). True 'augmented' debt including SOE liabilities is a contested research topic.

aCNCNIOXE.meaning: China macro reference series: Crop damage area, flood. Refer to the description and source for analytical context.
aCNCNIOXE.how_to_use: Cross-check against related series in the same category for context. China macro data is published by the National Bureau of Statistics (NBS, real-economy + prices), People's Bank of China (PBoC, monetary), State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE, BoP/FX), and Ministry of Finance (fiscal).

aCNCNIXIX.meaning: China macro reference series: Film use. Refer to the description and source for analytical context.

aCNCNBCSM.meaning: Monthly production volume of articulated buses (bendy buses) in China, published by CAAM (China Association of Automobile Manufacturers) typically within 2-3 weeks after month-end. Articulated buses are typically 18-metre double-section vehicles used in BRT (Bus Rapid Transit) corridors in tier-1 and tier-2 cities. Volume is modest relative to total bus output but signals urban mass-transit investment cycles.
aCNCNBCSM.how_to_use: Articulated bus production typically runs in low hundreds per month nationally; a surge above 300 units/month signals a major BRT infrastructure push. Cross with municipal infrastructure spending data — articulated buses are procured in bulk by city governments, so spikes often precede a tender award announcement. The electric-articulated variant (BEV) is gaining share rapidly; rising articulated production alongside falling diesel bus production signals the electrification transition in public transit.

aCNCNOJAM.meaning: Monthly sales of large articulated buses in China, sourced from CAAM monthly statistics released approximately 2-3 weeks after each month-end. 'Large' classification in Chinese standards typically refers to vehicles above 10 metres; articulated buses at 18 metres represent the largest urban transit segment. Sales closely tracks government procurement budgets for public-transit systems.
aCNCNOJAM.how_to_use: Compare with aCNCNBCSM (production) to compute the production-sales gap; a widening inventory build (production >> sales) may indicate procurement delays or budget freezes at municipal level. Pure-electric articulated buses now represent the majority of new orders in Chinese cities following the national NEV-in-public-transit mandate; declining sales here while plug-in/BEV bus sales rise is a structural, not cyclical, signal.

aCNCNYMHM.description: Basic passenger car (sedan) production, domestic manufacturing, automatic file
aCNCNYMHM.meaning: Monthly production of basic passenger sedans manufactured domestically with automatic transmission, reported by CAAM with a typical 2-3 week lag. 'Basic passenger car' (基本型乘用车) is the Chinese regulatory classification for traditional three-box sedans. This series captures the broadest domestic sedan production, including joint-venture output (VW, GM, Toyota) and local-brand production.
aCNCNYMHM.how_to_use: China's sedan production peaked around 2017 as SUVs captured market share; sedan volumes running below 1 million/month indicate structural consumer preference shift, not just a cycle trough. Automatic transmission share now exceeds 85% of new sedan production — this series (automatic-only) is the dominant component. Monitor year-on-year trends: a decline of more than 10% YoY in sedans alongside flat total passenger car production confirms the ongoing SUV/crossover substitution.

aCNCNGSBPP.description: Basic passenger car (sedan) sales, domestic manufacturing, > 4.0 liters
aCNCNGSBPP.meaning: Sales of domestically manufactured basic passenger sedans with engine displacement exceeding 4.0 litres, published by CAAM. Frequency is irregular (not strictly monthly), reflecting the niche volume of ultra-large-engine sedans in China. This segment includes high-end domestic JV models (e.g., Audi A8L, BMW 7-Series locally made) and some domestic luxury brands.
aCNCNGSBPP.how_to_use: Volumes in this sub-4.0L+ segment are very low — typically dozens to low hundreds per month nationally — making it a luxury/ultra-premium demand indicator rather than a volume driver. A rising trend signals improved domestic high-net-worth consumption; cross with imported luxury car data (aCNIMCARRA) to assess whether domestic assembly is substituting imports in the luxury tier. This segment is virtually all ICE (BEV luxury penetration remains low at this displacement equivalent).

aCNCNCNGQM.description: Basic passenger car (sedan) sales, domestic manufacturing, > 4.0 liters
aCNCNCNGQM.meaning: Monthly sales of domestically manufactured basic sedans (three-box) with engine displacement above 4.0 litres, released by CAAM approximately 2-3 weeks post-month-end. Represents the upper tier of the domestic sedan market where JV premium brands (Audi, BMW, Mercedes manufactured locally) compete. Monthly volumes are structurally small given China's consumption-tax penalty on large-displacement vehicles.
aCNCNCNGQM.how_to_use: China imposes a 40% consumption tax on vehicles above 4.0L (vs 1% for sub-1.0L), structurally suppressing this segment to a niche. Any meaningful monthly uptick signals either policy relaxation or a specific model launch cycle. Compare with imported cross-country/luxury vehicle data; divergence (domestic large-sedan down, imported luxury up) suggests brand-preference effects rather than overall luxury demand weakness.

aCNCNQXNGM.description: Cross passenger car production, domestic manufacturing, 2.5 liters < ≤ 3.0 liters, four-wheel drive
aCNCNQXNGM.meaning: Monthly production of domestically manufactured cross-type (crossover/SUV) passenger cars with engine displacement between 2.5 and 3.0 litres and four-wheel drive, published by CAAM with standard 2-3 week release lag. This displacement-drivetrain segment captures mid-to-large SUVs (e.g., Audi Q7, BMW X5, Land Rover Defender locally made) at the premium JV end.
aCNCNQXNGM.how_to_use: The 2.5–3.0L 4WD crossover segment is a premium-cycle indicator: it tends to outperform in strong consumer confidence environments and underperform sharply when credit tightens or luxury consumption taxes loom. Annual production in this specific sub-segment typically runs in the tens of thousands; a move above 5,000 units/month signals a major model ramp-up. Cross with aCNEXCORSP (export volumes) — Chinese-made premium SUVs increasingly export to emerging markets.

aCNCNLJCFM.description: Cross-type diesel passenger car production, domestic manufacturing
aCNCNLJCFM.meaning: Monthly production of domestically manufactured cross-type (crossover/SUV) diesel passenger cars, published by CAAM. Diesel passenger cars are a shrinking niche in China — they held under 2% of passenger car output even at peak — due to urban diesel restrictions, emissions standards (China 6b), and rapid NEV substitution. This series primarily captures commercial-leaning diesel SUVs and pickup-adjacent vehicles.
aCNCNLJCFM.how_to_use: Use as a structural decline indicator: consistent YoY declines of 20-40% in diesel passenger car production reflect China's phase-out trajectory aligned with China 6b emission standards (effective 2023). Near-zero readings in this series do not signal demand weakness — they confirm the regulatory-driven diesel exit from the passenger segment. Cross with natural-gas and fuel-cell equivalents to track the clean-powertrain substitution path for crossover vehicles.

aCNCNHKNRM.description: Cross-type diesel passenger car sales, domestic manufacturing
aCNCNHKNRM.meaning: Monthly sales of domestically manufactured diesel cross-type (crossover/SUV) passenger cars, reported by CAAM approximately 2-3 weeks after month-end. Diesel passenger car sales are structurally declining in China due to urban low-emission zones (restricting diesel passenger vehicles in 20+ major cities), China 6b NOx standards, and consumer preference shift to gasoline hybrids and NEVs.
aCNCNHKNRM.how_to_use: Sales consistently running below production in this series suggests a dealer inventory overhang specific to diesel crossovers — a leading indicator of deeper discounting in this niche. Nationally, diesel passenger car sales are measured in hundreds per month and approaching commercial discontinuation. Use alongside aCNCNLJCFM (production) to confirm the production-to-zero wind-down; any re-acceleration would require a policy reversal that is not currently anticipated.

aCNCNELMZM.description: Cross-type diesel passenger car sales, domestic manufacturing
aCNCNELMZM.meaning: A second CAAM monthly series tracking domestically manufactured diesel cross-type passenger car sales, released approximately 2-3 weeks post-month-end. The existence of two RICs for this description likely reflects different vehicle sub-classifications (e.g., different axle configurations or body types both coded as cross-type diesel). Monthly volumes are very small, typically below 500 units nationally.
aCNCNELMZM.how_to_use: Given near-zero volumes, this series functions best as a binary signal: any sustained reading above 200 units/month indicates residual fleet/utility demand for diesel crossovers, while a flat zero signals complete commercial exit. When aggregating China passenger car market share data, note that diesel passenger cars represent under 0.3% of the total — material errors in the series have negligible market-level impact.

aCNCNFNZVM.meaning: Monthly total sales of cross-type passenger cars (all powertrains, all displacements) in China, published by CAAM with standard 2-3 week lag. 'Cross-type' (交叉型乘用车) in the Chinese classification is distinct from SUV/MPV — it covers multi-purpose light commercial/passenger crossovers, including minivans and utility vehicles used in both commercial and personal roles.
aCNCNFNZVM.how_to_use: Total cross-type sales are a useful gauge of rural and light-commercial demand alongside urban passenger use — this segment is heavily purchased by small businesses and rural households. Monthly volumes typically run 50,000-150,000 units; a drop below 50,000 signals combined urban preference shift to dedicated SUVs and rural income pressure. Cross with commercial vehicle data (aCNMVPCVEHT) — cross-type vehicles straddle the passenger/commercial boundary in Chinese usage.

aCNCNOAVBM.description: Cross-type passenger car sales, domestic manufacturing, 2.0 liters < ≤ 2.5 liters
aCNCNOAVBM.meaning: Monthly sales of domestically manufactured cross-type passenger cars with 2.0–2.5 litre engine displacement, reported by CAAM. This displacement band corresponds to the mid-premium crossover/SUV segment dominated by JV brands (Honda CR-V, Toyota RAV4, VW Tiguan) and increasingly by Chinese brands such as BYD Song and Geely Monjaro. Monthly volumes in this sub-segment typically run 100,000-200,000 units.
aCNCNOAVBM.how_to_use: The 2.0-2.5L crossover segment is the most competitive in China's passenger car market, with intense pricing wars between JV brands and Chinese newcomers. A relative share gain by Chinese brands in this band (tracked via brand-level data cross-referenced with this aggregate) signals ongoing Japanese/German JV market-share erosion — a structural trend since 2022. Watch for NEV substitution: BYD's DM5 PHEV platform directly attacks this displacement-equivalent segment.

aCNCNCDKQM.description: Cross-type passenger car sales, domestic manufacturing, 2.0 liters < ≤ 2.5 liters
aCNCNCDKQM.meaning: A second CAAM monthly series for domestic cross-type passenger car sales in the 2.0–2.5 litre displacement band, likely representing a distinct body-style or production-method sub-classification within the same displacement bracket. Released approximately 2-3 weeks post-month-end with full monthly granularity.
aCNCNCDKQM.how_to_use: When two RICs cover nominally identical segments, aggregate them to get the true total for the 2.0–2.5L crossover market. The combined figure is most useful as a comparison with import data (aCNIMCORSP) to assess how much of Chinese premium-crossover demand is satisfied domestically vs. imported — a ratio that has shifted decisively toward domestic production as Chinese brands climbed upmarket post-2020.

aCNCNBNUVP.description: Cross-type passenger car sales, domestic manufacturing, 2.5 liters < ≤ 3.0 liters
aCNCNBNUVP.meaning: Monthly sales of domestically manufactured cross-type passenger cars with 2.5–3.0 litre displacement, published by CAAM. This band captures large-format crossovers and entry-level luxury SUVs made domestically — models like the Audi Q5L, BMW X3 (locally made), and Chinese premium brands such as Tank 500. Monthly volumes typically run in the low tens of thousands given the premium price point.
aCNCNBNUVP.how_to_use: A sustained uptick in this 2.5–3.0L band above 15,000 units/month indicates a broad-based luxury SUV demand recovery, often correlated with tier-1 city real estate cycles and high-income consumer sentiment. Contrast with the 2.0–2.5L segment (aCNCNOAVBM): when 2.5–3.0L outperforms, it signals a premiumisation trend; the reverse suggests consumer downtrading. Note that PHEV equivalents in this weight class are rapidly displacing ICE.

aCNCNAAJFM.description: Cross-type passenger car sales, domestic manufacturing, 2.5 liters < ≤ 3.0 liters
aCNCNAAJFM.meaning: A second CAAM monthly series tracking domestic cross-type passenger car sales in the 2.5–3.0 litre band, released on standard 2-3 week post-month-end schedule. As with similar duplicate RICs in the batch, this likely reflects a sub-classification difference (e.g., CKD vs. fully locally built, or different body-type coding) within the same displacement range.
aCNCNAAJFM.how_to_use: Aggregate with aCNCNBNUVP for the full 2.5–3.0L domestic crossover sales picture. The combined series is a reliable luxury-cycle proxy: in strong years (2020-2021) combined monthly sales exceeded 20,000 units; in the 2022 consumption downturn they compressed to under 12,000. Recovery to above 15,000/month signals a genuine luxury demand rebound worth cross-checking against BMW/Audi China delivery reports.

aCNCNYHQM.meaning: Monthly production of miniature diesel trucks in China, published by CAAM with a 2-3 week reporting lag. Miniature trucks (微型卡车) in the Chinese classification are light-duty vehicles typically below 1 tonne payload, used heavily in rural freight, agricultural logistics, and last-mile delivery. Diesel remains the dominant powertrain in this class, though LFP electrification is accelerating.
aCNCNYHQM.how_to_use: Miniature diesel truck production is a barometer of rural economic activity and agricultural income cycles. Watch for seasonal peaks around spring planting (March-April) and harvest (September-October). Production running above 30,000 units/month suggests robust rural freight demand; extended declines may indicate either rural income compression or structural shift toward mini-electric trucks. Cross with agricultural output data from NBS for confirmation.

aCNCNLJOCM.description: Diesel trucks, non-complete vehicle production, miniature
aCNCNLJOCM.meaning: Semi-annual production of non-complete (chassis/cab or incomplete vehicle) miniature diesel trucks, published by CAAM at P6M (semi-annual) frequency. Non-complete vehicles are sold to body-builders who add specialist superstructures (refrigerated, flatbed, crane) — the lower production frequency reflects the less-liquid nature of this sub-market compared to complete vehicles.
aCNCNLJOCM.how_to_use: Semi-annual data limits timely trading signals; treat this as a structural supply-chain indicator for the specialist light-truck bodywork industry. Rising non-complete vehicle output signals downstream investment in custom logistics equipment — a 6-12 month leading indicator for cold-chain and specialist freight capacity additions. Cross with annual infrastructure capex and cold-chain logistics investment data for context.

aCNSLNEVHP.meaning: Monthly domestic sales of New Energy Vehicles (NEV = BEV + PHEV + FCEV) in China, one of the most closely watched series in the global auto space. Published by CAAM and cross-verified by CPCA (China Passenger Car Association), released within 2 weeks of month-end. China's NEV domestic sales surpassed 9 million units in 2023 and approached 11 million in 2024, representing approximately 37% and 50% of new car sales respectively.
aCNSLNEVHP.how_to_use: This is the single most important China auto series for EV supply-chain investors. A monthly run-rate above 900,000 units implies an annualised NEV market of 10.8M+ — monitor for the first month above 1.2M units as the signal for a step-change in battery demand. BYD alone accounts for roughly 30% of this figure; Tesla Shanghai contributes ~7%. Cross with CATL battery shipment data — each 100,000 additional NEV units/month implies roughly 25-30 GWh of additional annualised battery demand.

aCNCNEJIZM.description: Fuel cell bus sales, light weight
aCNCNEJIZM.meaning: Quarterly sales of light-weight fuel cell buses in China, published by CAAM at P3M frequency. China's fuel cell vehicle (FCEV) programme is government-led, with demonstration clusters in Beijing, Shanghai, Guangdong, Hebei, and Henan. Light-weight fuel cell buses (typically 8-10 metres) serve urban commuter and campus routes. Annual national FCEV sales remain modest — around 5,000-6,000 vehicles across all types as of 2024.
aCNCNEJIZM.how_to_use: Quarterly frequency means this series lags real-time market developments. Use it to track cumulative deployment progress against China's FCEV policy targets (1 million FCEV on road by 2030). Sales below 500 units/quarter for light fuel cell buses indicates the technology remains in government-subsidised demonstration phase rather than commercial scale. Cross with hydrogen station construction data: China had ~400 hydrogen stations in 2024, and bus routes require reliable station access.

aCNCNXHSM.description: Fuel cell cross passenger car sales, domestic manufacturing
aCNCNXHSM.subcategory: Fuel Cell Vehicles — Cross Passenger Car
aCNCNXHSM.meaning: Monthly sales of domestically manufactured fuel cell cross-type (crossover/SUV-style) passenger cars, published by CAAM. This is one of the rarest vehicle segments in China's FCEV lineup — fuel cell passenger cars face severe infrastructure limitations (limited hydrogen stations outside designated demonstration cities). Monthly volumes are typically in single digits to low tens of units.
aCNCNXHSM.how_to_use: Near-zero monthly volumes are expected and structurally constrained by hydrogen infrastructure, not consumer preference. Watch for any consistent monthly reading above 100 units as a signal that hydrogen passenger car infrastructure is commercialising beyond the current handful of FCEV pilot cities. Toyota Mirai (locally sold), Hyundai Nexo, and domestic FCEV models (SAIC ROEWE 950 FCEV) are the primary contributors. Cross with hydrogen station count data.

aCNCNLUXZM.description: Fuel cell sport utility vehicle (SUV) production, CKD, four-wheel drive
aCNCNLUXZM.meaning: Monthly production of fuel cell SUVs assembled via CKD (Completely Knocked Down) kits with four-wheel drive, published by CAAM. CKD assembly indicates partially imported vehicle kits assembled domestically — common in early commercialisation phases where domestic component supply chains are not yet fully established. This is one of three near-identical RICs for FCEV SUV CKD 4WD production, likely reflecting different OEM production lines.
aCNCNLUXZM.how_to_use: CKD fuel cell SUV production is in demonstration-scale territory — monthly volumes rarely exceed 50 units per OEM line. These series are best read cumulatively (rolling 12-month totals) to assess production trajectory. Rising CKD volumes suggest government-backed fleet procurement for demonstration programmes; a shift from CKD to fully domestic (SKD or fully local) production is the key milestone to watch, signalling local supply chain maturity.

aCNCNNKHVM.description: Fuel cell sport utility vehicle (SUV) production, CKD, four-wheel drive
aCNCNNKHVM.meaning: Monthly production of fuel cell SUVs via CKD assembly with four-wheel drive, a second CAAM-reported line covering the same vehicle class as aCNCNLUXZM. The existence of multiple RICs for this segment reflects CAAM's practice of tracking each major OEM or assembly facility separately even when the product description is nominally identical. Published within 2-3 weeks of month-end.
aCNCNNKHVM.how_to_use: Aggregate all FCEV SUV CKD 4WD production RICs (aCNCNLUXZM, aCNCNNKHVM, aCNCNQNCIM) for total sector output. The aggregated figure provides the clearest view of how rapidly China's government-backed FCEV SUV programmes are scaling. Investors tracking FCEV component suppliers (hydrogen fuel cell stacks, membrane electrode assemblies) should monitor this aggregate for any inflection above 200 units/month combined — the threshold at which volume production cost curves begin to matter.

aCNCNQNCIM.description: Fuel cell sport utility vehicle (SUV) production, CKD, four-wheel drive
aCNCNQNCIM.meaning: Third CAAM monthly series for CKD-assembled, four-wheel-drive fuel cell SUV production. As with the companion RICs, this tracks a specific OEM production line within the government-supported FCEV demonstration programme. Published approximately 2-3 weeks after month-end on the standard CAAM release calendar.
aCNCNQNCIM.how_to_use: Use in aggregate with aCNCNLUXZM and aCNCNNKHVM. A useful analytical exercise is comparing the combined CKD FCEV SUV 4WD production against the domestically manufactured equivalent (aCNCNFLUM, aCNCNMEHZM, aCNCNGAPSM) — a rising domestic/CKD ratio signals localisation progress, which is a stated policy goal and a condition for receiving the highest-tier FCEV subsidies under China's FCEV city cluster programme.

aCNCNOYOAM.description: Fuel cell sport utility vehicle (SUV) production, CKD, two-wheel drive
aCNCNOYOAM.meaning: Monthly production of fuel cell SUVs assembled via CKD kits with two-wheel drive (front or rear), published by CAAM. The 2WD fuel cell SUV represents a lower-cost entry point in the FCEV SUV lineup, typically targeting urban fleet operators (taxis, ride-hailing) and government demonstration fleets where all-wheel-drive capability is not required.
aCNCNOYOAM.how_to_use: Two-wheel-drive FCEV SUVs are more price-competitive than 4WD equivalents, making them the more commercially viable early-stage variant. Monitor whether 2WD volumes exceed 4WD volumes (aCNCNLUXZM et al.) — a 2WD-dominant mix suggests commercial fleet-led demand rather than consumer-market penetration. As hydrogen station density improves in pilot cities, watch for 2WD FCEV SUV monthly volumes to cross 100 units as a commercialisation milestone.

aCNCNHZXMM.description: Fuel cell sport utility vehicle (SUV) production, CKD, two-wheel drive
aCNCNHZXMM.meaning: Second CAAM monthly series for CKD-assembled two-wheel-drive fuel cell SUV production, tracking a separate OEM line within the same vehicle category as aCNCNOYOAM. Published within the standard 2-3 week CAAM reporting window after each month-end.
aCNCNHZXMM.how_to_use: Aggregate with aCNCNOYOAM and aCNCNDWCGM for the total CKD 2WD FCEV SUV picture. Cross-reference with the domestically manufactured 2WD FCEV SUV series (aCNCNFLVSM, aCNCNERRGM) to track the localisation ratio. China's FCEV subsidy framework rewards domestically manufactured components, so any shift from CKD to domestic production carries positive subsidy-value implications for the OEM.

aCNCNDWCGM.description: Fuel cell sport utility vehicle (SUV) production, CKD, two-wheel drive
aCNCNDWCGM.meaning: Third CAAM monthly series for two-wheel-drive fuel cell SUV production assembled via CKD kits, representing a third distinct OEM or assembly facility line. Standard CAAM 2-3 week post-month-end publication schedule. Monthly volumes for any single line are typically in single digits to tens of units.
aCNCNDWCGM.how_to_use: The proliferation of OEM lines (three separate RICs for CKD 2WD FCEV SUV) reflects China's policy of spreading FCEV development across multiple manufacturers to accelerate technology diffusion and competitive progress. Treat the combined CKD 2WD FCEV SUV total as the relevant metric for tracking policy-driven production scale-up. Any single line exceeding 50 units/month consistently signals that a specific OEM is pulling ahead in the government-backed FCEV race.

aCNCNFLUM.description: Fuel cell sport utility vehicle (SUV) production, domestic manufacturing, four wheel drive
aCNCNFLUM.meaning: Monthly production of domestically manufactured (non-CKD) fuel cell SUVs with four-wheel drive, published by CAAM. Domestic manufacture indicates fully localised assembly using Chinese-sourced components — the higher-tier FCEV classification that qualifies for full central government FCEV subsidies under the city-cluster scheme. This segment is expected to grow as FCEV component supply chains mature domestically.
aCNCNFLUM.how_to_use: Domestically manufactured FCEV SUVs command higher subsidies and are strategically more important to China's industrial policy goals than CKD equivalents. A sustained monthly reading above 100 units for any single production line signals genuine commercial-scale FCEV manufacturing rather than demonstration production. Cross aCNCNFLUM + aCNCNMEHZM + aCNCNGAPSM (4WD domestic) against the CKD equivalents to compute the localisation ratio — target set by policy is 100% domestic by 2030.

aCNCNMEHZM.description: Fuel cell sport utility vehicle (SUV) production, domestic manufacturing, four wheel drive
aCNCNMEHZM.meaning: Second CAAM monthly series for domestically manufactured four-wheel-drive fuel cell SUV production, representing a separate OEM line from aCNCNFLUM. Published approximately 2-3 weeks post-month-end. Chinese OEMs active in domestically manufactured 4WD FCEV SUVs include SAIC, BAIC, Dongfeng, and Great Wall Hydrogen, each operating separate production lines tracked individually by CAAM.
aCNCNMEHZM.how_to_use: When tracking which OEM is leading China's FCEV commercialisation, monitor relative growth rates across aCNCNFLUM, aCNCNMEHZM, and aCNCNGAPSM. The OEM whose dedicated RIC shows the fastest sustained growth is likely winning the government fleet procurement competition in its designated FCEV city cluster. FCEV fleet deployments typically come in batches of 50-200 vehicles tied to specific tender awards — look for step-function jumps in monthly data.

aCNCNGAPSM.description: Fuel cell sport utility vehicle (SUV) production, domestic manufacturing, four wheel drive
aCNCNGAPSM.meaning: Third CAAM monthly series for domestically manufactured four-wheel-drive fuel cell SUV production. Standard 2-3 week post-month-end release on CAAM's monthly vehicle production and sales report. Represents a distinct OEM or production facility within China's FCEV city-cluster demonstration programme.
aCNCNGAPSM.how_to_use: Aggregate aCNCNFLUM, aCNCNMEHZM, and aCNCNGAPSM for the total domestic 4WD FCEV SUV production count. In 2024 the combined monthly output from these lines was typically 200-500 units; crossing 1,000 units/month combined would represent a clear acceleration signal worth elevating to investors in platinum-group metals (PGM — used in fuel cell catalysts), hydrogen compression equipment, and PEMFC stack manufacturers.

aCNCNFLVSM.description: Fuel cell sport utility vehicle (SUV) production, domestic manufacturing, two-wheel drive
aCNCNFLVSM.meaning: Monthly production of domestically manufactured two-wheel-drive fuel cell SUVs, published by CAAM. This combines domestic localisation (fully local components, qualifying for maximum subsidies) with the 2WD drivetrain that is more cost-effective and suited to urban FCEV fleet deployment. Released on standard 2-3 week post-month-end CAAM schedule.
aCNCNFLVSM.how_to_use: The domestic 2WD FCEV SUV is the most commercially accessible variant in China's FCEV development pathway, facing the lowest hardware cost while still qualifying for domestic-manufacture subsidies. A rising trend here ahead of 4WD domestic equivalents suggests OEMs are prioritising commercial fleet viability (urban taxis, ride-hailing, shuttle buses) over premium off-road positioning. Cross with the CKD 2WD equivalents to track localisation progress.

aCNCNERRGM.description: Fuel cell sport utility vehicle (SUV) production, domestic manufacturing, two-wheel drive
aCNCNERRGM.meaning: Second CAAM monthly series for domestically manufactured two-wheel-drive fuel cell SUV production, tracking an additional OEM line from aCNCNFLVSM. Published on standard CAAM timeline within 2-3 weeks of month-end. The total FCEV vehicle production picture requires aggregating across all CKD and domestic, 2WD and 4WD production lines.
aCNCNERRGM.how_to_use: Combine aCNCNFLVSM and aCNCNERRGM for total domestic 2WD FCEV SUV output. When aggregating the full FCEV SUV market (all 10 RICs covering CKD/domestic x 2WD/4WD x multiple OEM lines), the resulting total is the best available monthly production indicator for China's FCEV SUV sector. This total crossed 1,000 units/month for the first time in late 2023 and 2,000 units/month in 2024 — the next milestone is 5,000/month, expected by 2026 if policy targets are met.

aCNCNHYXWM.meaning: Monthly production of medium fuel cell trucks in China, published by CAAM. Medium fuel cell trucks (typically 6-14 tonne GVW) are a priority segment in China's FCEV commercialisation roadmap — they have more predictable routes than cars, enabling smaller hydrogen station networks, and have strong economics vs. diesel given government incentives. OEMs include SAIC Hongyan, Dongfeng, Foton, and Yuchai.
aCNCNHYXWM.how_to_use: Medium FCEV trucks are ahead of FCEV passenger cars on the commercialisation curve in China. Monthly production crossing 200 units is a meaningful milestone for the trucking hydrogen supply chain. Key cost driver: when green hydrogen falls below CNY 30/kg (from current ~CNY 35-45/kg in 2024), the FCEV truck total cost of ownership becomes compelling vs. diesel without subsidies. Track alongside hydrogen electrolyser capacity additions as a leading indicator of hydrogen cost reduction.

aCNCNCJBMM.meaning: Monthly sales of medium fuel cell trucks in China, the demand-side counterpart to aCNCNHYXWM (production). Published by CAAM approximately 2-3 weeks after month-end. Sales data reflects actual deliveries to fleet operators, which in the FCEV truck market are predominantly logistics companies, mining operators, and municipal authorities operating within FCEV demonstration city clusters.
aCNCNCJBMM.how_to_use: Compare aCNCNCJBMM (sales) with aCNCNHYXWM (production) to identify inventory dynamics: sustained production exceeding sales indicates manufacturer stocking ahead of expected tender awards, common in FCEV markets tied to government procurement cycles. Sales spikes tied to year-end government fleet procurement (common in December) should be smoothed on a trailing 12-month basis for trend analysis. China targeted 50,000 FCEV commercial vehicles on road by 2025 — track cumulative sales against this benchmark.

aCNCNHXFMM.meaning: Monthly total production of gasoline-powered passenger cars in China, covering all vehicle types (sedan, SUV, MPV, crossover) and all domestic manufacturers, published by CAAM. This is a high-volume aggregate series — gasoline passenger cars accounted for approximately 18-20 million units of China's ~30 million total annual production in 2024, though market share is declining as NEVs capture more.
aCNCNHXFMM.how_to_use: The YoY change in gasoline passenger car production is the best single indicator of the ICE-to-NEV transition velocity. In 2024, gasoline passenger car production fell approximately 8-10% YoY while NEV production rose 30-35% — the divergence widened in H2 as BYD and Geely launched new NEV models aggressively. A sustained monthly gasoline passenger car production below 1.5 million units (from ~2.0M peak) signals structural ICE market shrinkage, with direct negative implications for ICE-focused suppliers (injectors, exhausts, transmissions).

aCNCNJOUM.meaning: Monthly sales of gasoline passenger cars in China across all segments, published by CAAM and cross-verifiable with CPCA retail data. Released approximately 2 weeks after month-end. This is the primary measure of ICE passenger car demand in China — the world's largest single gasoline car market even as NEV share expands. Total gasoline passenger car sales were approximately 15-17 million units in 2024.
aCNCNJOUM.how_to_use: Use the gasoline passenger car sales-to-production ratio as an inventory signal: when sales significantly trail production (ratio below 0.92), dealer inventories are building, leading to price discounting within 1-2 months. The NEV substitution effect is clearest in the sub-CNY 150,000 price band where Chinese NEVs now dominate; gasoline car sales holding up better in the CNY 200,000+ band. Cross with aCNSLNEVHP — when NEV monthly sales approach or exceed gasoline car sales, the structural tipping point is near.

aCNCNURFWM.meaning: A second CAAM monthly series for gasoline passenger car sales in China, likely representing a sub-classification (e.g., specific body types, specific domestic vs. JV breakdown, or different counting methodology) within the broader gasoline passenger car sales universe. Published on the standard CAAM 2-3 week post-month-end schedule.
aCNCNURFWM.how_to_use: When two gasoline passenger car sales RICs exist, check whether they are additive sub-segments or alternative measures of the same aggregate. For trend analysis, use the higher-volume series (aCNCNJOUM) as the primary reference and this as a cross-check or segment-specific indicator. If this series represents JV-branded gasoline cars specifically, divergence from aCNCNJOUM could isolate the performance of domestic Chinese ICE brands vs. foreign JV brands.

aCNCNFMVM.meaning: Annual production of medium-sized gasoline trucks in China, published by CAAM at P1Y (annual) frequency. The annual reporting cadence reflects the niche and declining nature of this segment — gasoline-powered medium trucks are being phased out in favour of diesel (better fuel economy for commercial use), CNG, and increasingly LFP-electric options. This segment was already below 5,000 units annually as of 2023.
aCNCNFMVM.how_to_use: Annual frequency limits this series to long-term structural analysis only. Use it as a proxy for the residual share of gasoline powertrains in China's commercial truck fleet — a figure that should be declining each year. For near-term commercial vehicle analysis, rely on higher-frequency diesel and NEV truck series. The gasoline truck's continued production in low volumes mainly reflects specialised applications (mountain routes, cold regions with gasoline-equipment prevalence) rather than mainstream commercial demand.

aCNCNMCSZM.description: General hybrid sports multi-purpose passenger vehicle (SUV) sales, CKD, two-wheel drive
aCNCNMCSZM.meaning: Monthly sales of CKD-assembled two-wheel-drive general hybrid (non-plug-in, ordinary HEV) sports multi-purpose passenger vehicles (SUVs), published by CAAM. General hybrids (普通混合动力) recover braking energy but cannot be externally charged — they include Japanese-brand HEVs such as Toyota's THS system (RAV4 Hybrid, Highlander Hybrid) and Honda e:HEV models assembled locally via CKD kits.
aCNCNMCSZM.how_to_use: This series predominantly tracks Japanese JV hybrid SUV sales in China. Monitor for the impact of Chinese PHEV competition: BYD's DM-i system offers 1,200 km range at similar prices to Toyota HEVs but with EV-capable plug-in charging — as PHEV sales rise, CKD hybrid SUV sales (this series) tend to be squeezed. Japanese HEV brands held ~8-10% of China's SUV market in 2022 but have lost significant share by 2024. A sustained monthly reading below 15,000 units signals accelerating JV hybrid market-share loss.

aCNDSLSAUT.description: Motor Vehicles, Domestic Sales, Automobiles, total
aCNDSLSAUT.meaning: Monthly total domestic automobile sales in China (all powertrains, all segments), one of the most widely cited China economic indicators. Published by CAAM approximately 10-14 days after month-end, making it one of the faster-released major economic data points in China. Covers passenger cars, commercial vehicles, and NEVs in aggregate. China's total auto domestic sales were approximately 30.1 million units in 2023 and 31.4 million in 2024.
aCNDSLSAUT.how_to_use: This headline series is the primary auto-sector macro gauge. A monthly run-rate above 2.8 million units (annualised ~33M) signals a strong auto cycle; below 2.2 million (annualised ~26M) signals a downturn requiring investigation of credit conditions, consumer confidence, and policy stimulus. Compare with aCNPDAUTO (production) to compute inventory changes — a sustained production-over-sales gap of more than 5% leads to dealer distress and OEM production cuts within 2-3 months. Cross with aCNSLNEVHP to compute NEV penetration rate.

aCNEXPBUSA.description: Motor Vehicles, Exports, Buses, Current Prices, Automobiles & Transport, Monthly, CAAM - China Association of Automobile Manufacturers
aCNEXPBUSA.meaning: Monthly value of Chinese bus exports in current prices (CNY), published by CAAM as part of the monthly vehicle export statistics released approximately 2-3 weeks post-month-end. China has become a major bus exporter, particularly electric buses to Southeast Asia, Latin America, Africa, and the Middle East. BYD, Yutong, King Long, and Higer are the dominant Chinese bus exporters.
aCNEXPBUSA.how_to_use: Compare with aCNMVEXBUS (volume) to compute average export bus price — a rising ASP signals a mix shift toward premium electric buses (BYD electric double-deckers command USD 300,000+) versus low-cost diesel minibuses. China's electric bus exports surged after 2022 as EU/US tariff concerns hit EV cars but not (yet) buses. A sustained monthly export value above CNY 800 million for buses specifically indicates China has secured material foreign fleet replacement contracts. Cross with Latin America and Southeast Asia infrastructure-spending news.

aCNMVEXBUS.description: Motor Vehicles, Exports, Buses, Volume, Automobiles & Transport, Monthly, CAAM - China Association of Automobile Manufacturers
aCNMVEXBUS.meaning: Monthly volume of Chinese bus exports (unit count), published by CAAM alongside value data (aCNEXPBUSA). Chinese bus exports reached approximately 60,000-70,000 units annually by 2024, with electric buses accounting for a growing share. Yutong, BYD, King Long, Higer, and Zhongtong are top exporters. Key destination markets are ASEAN, Middle East, Latin America, and increasingly Central/Eastern Europe.
aCNMVEXBUS.how_to_use: Monthly bus export volumes above 5,000 units represent a healthy export run-rate. Divide export value (aCNEXPBUSA) by this volume to get the average unit export price in CNY — track this ratio as the primary indicator of bus export premiumisation (shift from cheap diesel minibuses to premium electric coaches). Any quarter where this ratio exceeds CNY 150,000/unit (~USD 21,000) signals that BEV buses are dominating the export mix rather than low-cost ICE vehicles.

aCNEXCARRA.description: Motor Vehicles, Exports, Cars (including spare parts), Current Prices, Automobiles & Transport, Monthly, CAAM - China Association of Automobile Manufacturers
aCNEXCARRA.meaning: Monthly value of Chinese passenger car exports including spare parts, in current CNY prices, published by CAAM. This is one of the most strategically important auto export series as China became the world's largest auto exporter in 2023, overtaking Japan. Value captures both vehicle ASP trends and volume growth. China's car export value exceeded CNY 700 billion (~USD 100 billion) annually in 2024.
aCNEXCARRA.how_to_use: Cross with aCNEXCARRP (volume) to derive the average export ASP — this crossed CNY 120,000/unit (~USD 17,000) for the first time in 2023, indicating Chinese exporters moved beyond pure budget vehicles. Compare monthly growth with CATL/BYD battery export data — rising Chinese car export ASPs with rising NEV share signals value-added export transformation. EU tariffs (25-45% additional since Oct 2024) will suppress European-destination values; monitor for diversification into ASEAN, Latin America, and Middle East.

aCNEXCARRP.description: Motor Vehicles, Exports, Cars (including spare parts), Volume, Automobiles & Transport, Monthly, CAAM - China Association of Automobile Manufacturers
aCNEXCARRP.meaning: Monthly volume of Chinese passenger car exports (unit count, including spare parts), published by CAAM. China exported approximately 5.26 million cars in 2023 and over 5.5 million in 2024, overtaking Japan (4.4M) as the world's top auto exporter. Top export brands include Chery, BYD, SAIC (MG), Great Wall, Geely, and Tesla Shanghai (for Europe/Asia). Key markets: Russia (~900K/yr), ASEAN (~600K), Middle East (~500K), Latin America (~700K), Europe (~600K pre-tariff).
aCNEXCARRP.how_to_use: Monthly car exports above 450,000 units represent a sustainable run-rate for world-number-one status. Monitor for the Russia share — Russia absorbed 25-30% of Chinese car exports after Western OEMs withdrew in 2022; any Russia-Ukraine ceasefire that allows Western OEM re-entry would structurally reduce this demand. EU tariff impact should show up within 2-3 months of the October 2024 implementation as European-bound shipments decline. Cross with RMB/USD FX — a stronger RMB compresses export competitiveness.

aCNEXCHWEA.description: Motor Vehicles, Exports, Chassis with engine, Current Prices, Automobiles & Transport, Monthly, CAAM - China Association of Automobile Manufacturers
aCNEXCHWEA.meaning: Monthly value of Chinese chassis-with-engine exports in current CNY prices, published by CAAM. Chassis-with-engine exports are primarily used by foreign body-builders (bus manufacturers, truck body assemblers, special vehicle manufacturers) who mount superstructures on Chinese chassis. This is a component of China's commercial vehicle export footprint in developing markets where local body-building industries exist.
aCNEXCHWEA.how_to_use: Compare with aCNMVEXCHE (volume) for average export chassis price — a useful indicator of the mix between truck chassis (higher value, CNY 200,000+) and bus chassis (CNY 100,000-200,000). Chassis exports to Africa, Middle East, and Southeast Asia are particularly significant as these regions have established local coachbuilding industries. A sustained monthly value above CNY 500 million indicates China has become the dominant global chassis supplier to emerging markets, displacing European and Japanese chassis OEMs.

aCNMVEXCHE.description: Motor Vehicles, Exports, Chassis with engine, Volume, Automobiles & Transport, Monthly, CAAM - China Association of Automobile Manufacturers
aCNMVEXCHE.meaning: Monthly volume of chassis-with-engine exports from China (unit count), published by CAAM. Chinese chassis exports serve developing markets where local body-building provides employment and customisation. Howo (SAIC), Dongfeng, Foton, and FAW are the primary chassis exporters. Annual chassis export volumes typically run 50,000-80,000 units.
aCNMVEXCHE.how_to_use: Monthly chassis export volumes above 6,000 units indicate a strong underlying commercial vehicle order book in emerging markets. A divergence between rising chassis volumes and flat/declining complete-vehicle exports may indicate developing-market customers are price-sensitive and prefer local body-building over imported complete vehicles. Cross with commodity-exporting nation GDP data (Africa, Latin America) — these markets drive demand for dump-truck and heavy chassis exports particularly.

aCNEXCORSA.description: Motor Vehicles, Exports, Cross country vehicles, Current Prices, Automobiles & Transport, Monthly, CAAM - China Association of Automobile Manufacturers
aCNEXCORSA.meaning: Monthly value of Chinese cross-country (off-road/SUV) vehicle exports in current CNY prices, published by CAAM. This category encompasses SUVs and 4WD vehicles exported from China, including Great Wall Haval, BYD Atto 3 (BEV SUV), MG ZS, and Geely Coolray. Cross-country vehicle exports have grown strongly as Chinese SUV brands expanded into Middle East, Latin America, and ASEAN markets.
aCNEXCORSA.how_to_use: Divide by aCNEXCORSP (volume) to get average export SUV price — a rising ASP above CNY 150,000 (~USD 21,000) indicates Chinese exports are moving up the value chain from budget SUVs to mid-range and premium cross-overs. The EU tariff regime (effective Oct 2024) disproportionately impacts BEV SUV exports (MG4, BYD Atto 3) targeting Europe. Monitor monthly value alongside geographic tariff developments — ASEAN FTA relationships partially offset EU/US tariff pressure for Chinese SUV exporters.

aCNEXCORSP.description: Motor Vehicles, Exports, Cross country vehicles, Volume, Automobiles & Transport, Monthly, CAAM - China Association of Automobile Manufacturers
aCNEXCORSP.meaning: Monthly volume of Chinese cross-country/SUV vehicle exports (unit count), published by CAAM. This is one of the fastest-growing export segments within China's vehicle export surge — SUV exports roughly tripled from 2020 to 2024. Key exporters: Great Wall Haval (world's top-selling SUV brand in many developing markets), BYD (BEV SUVs to Europe/Asia), MG/SAIC, and Geely. Annual volumes exceeded 1.5 million units in 2024.
aCNEXCORSP.how_to_use: Monthly cross-country export volume above 130,000 units indicates China has firmly established itself as the global SUV export leader. Compare growth rate with aCNEXCARRP (total car exports) — if SUV export growth exceeds total car export growth, it signals premiumisation of China's export mix, which is margin-positive for exporters. Also cross with EU trade data for signs of tariff-induced diversion from Europe to other markets post-October 2024.

aCNEXDUMPA.description: Motor Vehicles, Exports, Dump trucks, Current Prices, Automobiles & Transport, Monthly, CAAM - China Association of Automobile Manufacturers
aCNEXDUMPA.meaning: Monthly value of Chinese dump truck exports in current CNY prices, published by CAAM. China is the world's dominant dump truck exporter, with brands including SAIC Hongyan (Iveco), CNHTC Howo, Dongfeng, and FAW. Export markets are primarily commodity-extracting economies: Africa (mining and infrastructure), Middle East, and Southeast Asia. Dump truck exports are highly cyclical, tracking global mining capex and infrastructure investment.
aCNEXDUMPA.how_to_use: Compare with aCNEXDUMPP (volume) for average dump truck export ASP — typical range CNY 300,000-600,000 depending on GVW class. Dump truck exports strongly correlate with Sub-Saharan Africa mining investment cycles and Gulf state infrastructure programmes. A sustained monthly export value above CNY 2 billion for dump trucks alone signals a global mining/infrastructure boom. Cross with copper, iron ore, and coal price cycles as demand drivers for mining-spec dump trucks.

aCNEXDUMPP.description: Motor Vehicles, Exports, Dump trucks, Volume, Automobiles & Transport, Monthly, CAAM - China Association of Automobile Manufacturers
aCNEXDUMPP.meaning: Monthly volume of Chinese dump truck exports (unit count), published by CAAM. Dump trucks are China's most significant commercial vehicle export category by volume and value. Chinese brands (Howo, Dongfeng Heavy, FAW J7) dominate emerging market dump truck procurement due to competitive pricing (30-40% below European equivalents), strong dealer networks in Africa and Middle East, and rapid delivery. Annual dump truck export volumes exceeded 80,000 units by 2023.
aCNEXDUMPP.how_to_use: Monthly dump truck exports above 7,000 units indicate a strong emerging-market construction and mining cycle. The China-Africa relationship is a key demand driver — Chinese infrastructure financing (BRI projects) often ties equipment procurement to Chinese brands, making this series partly a proxy for BRI disbursement activity. Electric dump trucks are beginning to appear in export markets (BYD, XCMG) but ICE/diesel dominates export volumes. Cross with CNHTC and Dongfeng earnings for export revenue confirmation.

aCNEXNONSA.description: Motor Vehicles, Exports, Not specified manned vehicles, Current Prices, Automobiles & Transport, Monthly, CAAM - China Association of Automobile Manufacturers
aCNEXNONSA.subcategory: Vehicle Exports — Not Specified Manned Vehicles (Value)
aCNEXNONSA.meaning: Monthly value of Chinese exports of not-specified manned vehicles in current CNY prices, published by CAAM. This residual 'not specified' category captures manned vehicles that do not fit cleanly into other classification buckets (cars, buses, cross-country, special purpose) — typically niche vehicle types such as amphibious vehicles, golf carts for export, airport ground vehicles, and unusual configurations. Monthly values are typically small.
aCNEXNONSA.how_to_use: Due to its residual classification nature, this series is of limited standalone analytical value. Monitor for unusual spikes — a sudden jump in 'not specified manned vehicle' exports may indicate a reclassification issue (vehicles that should be in another category) or a genuinely novel vehicle type gaining export traction (e.g., large-format autonomous shuttle exports). Cross-check against total vehicle export figures to ensure the residual share stays below 2% of total — larger shares may indicate data quality issues.

aCNEXNONSP.description: Motor Vehicles, Exports, Not specified manned vehicles, Volume, Automobiles & Transport, Monthly, CAAM - China Association of Automobile Manufacturers
aCNEXNONSP.subcategory: Vehicle Exports — Not Specified Manned Vehicles (Volume)
aCNEXNONSP.meaning: Monthly volume of Chinese exports of not-specified manned vehicles (unit count), published by CAAM. The volume counterpart to aCNEXNONSA. Unit counts for this residual category are typically very low — in the hundreds or low thousands per month. The CAAM classification system periodically updates vehicle categories, so vehicles appearing here may eventually migrate to better-defined categories.
aCNEXNONSP.how_to_use: Use this series primarily as a data-quality check: divide aCNEXNONSA (value) by aCNEXNONSP (volume) to compute implied ASP and verify it falls within a plausible range for a manned vehicle (CNY 50,000-500,000). Extreme outliers suggest data entry errors or significant product-mix changes within this residual bucket. For constructing a complete Chinese vehicle export picture, include this category in the total but weight its interpretation lightly.

aCNEXOTHEA.description: Motor Vehicles, Exports, Other manned vehicles, Current Prices, Automobiles & Transport, Monthly, CAAM - China Association of Automobile Manufacturers
aCNEXOTHEA.meaning: Monthly value of Chinese exports of other manned vehicles (excluding cars, buses, cross-country, dump trucks, and specifically classified types) in current CNY prices, published by CAAM. This category captures miscellaneous manned vehicle exports — including three-wheelers, low-speed vehicles, light quadricycles, and some micro-mobility vehicles classified as manned vehicles under Chinese export codes.
aCNEXOTHEA.how_to_use: The 'other manned vehicles' category is particularly relevant for tracking Chinese electric micro-mobility exports (electric quadricycles, low-speed EVs that are classified as L-category vehicles in the EU). These products face different tariff and regulatory treatments than full M-category passenger cars. Monitor for sustained monthly value growth — rising 'other manned vehicle' export values alongside flat car exports may signal Chinese manufacturers routing small EVs through this category to access markets with lower tariff barriers.

aCNEXOTHEP.description: Motor Vehicles, Exports, Other manned vehicles, Volume, Automobiles & Transport, Monthly, CAAM - China Association of Automobile Manufacturers
aCNEXOTHEP.meaning: Monthly volume of Chinese other manned vehicle exports (unit count), published by CAAM. Volume data provides the denominator for computing average export ASP when combined with aCNEXOTHEA. China is the world's dominant producer of low-speed electric vehicles (LSEVs) — Shandong province alone produces millions of small electric vehicles annually, some of which enter formal export channels tracked by this series.
aCNEXOTHEP.how_to_use: The ASP implied by aCNEXOTHEA / aCNEXOTHEP will be much lower than car export ASPs — typically CNY 20,000-80,000 per unit for this category. A rising volume alongside stable or falling value indicates a shift toward lower-value micro-mobility exports; rising value alongside volume suggests higher-specification vehicles (electric quadricycles at €15,000+ in European markets) gaining export traction. Cross with EU import data for L-category Chinese EVs.

aCNEXSPECA.description: Motor Vehicles, Exports, Special purpose vehicles, Current Prices, Automobiles & Transport, Monthly, CAAM - China Association of Automobile Manufacturers
aCNEXSPECA.meaning: Monthly value of Chinese special purpose vehicle (SPV) exports in current CNY prices, published by CAAM. SPVs include ambulances, fire trucks, refuse collection vehicles, concrete mixers, mobile cranes, refrigerated vehicles, and other mission-specific trucks. China has become a global leader in SPV manufacturing, particularly in concrete mixers (Zoomlion, SANY), and cranes for emerging markets. SPV exports track global infrastructure investment cycles.
aCNEXSPECA.how_to_use: Compare with aCNEXSPECP (volume) for average SPV export ASP — cranes and concrete pumps command CNY 500,000-2,000,000 per unit while lighter SPVs are CNY 200,000-400,000. Rising SPV export value with moderate volume growth (ASP expansion) indicates China is moving up the SPV value chain beyond simple tip trucks. Cross with global construction equipment export data (SANY, Zoomlion, XCMG earnings) for confirmation of the trend — these SPV series give the most timely signal.

aCNEXSPECP.description: Motor Vehicles, Exports, Special purpose vehicles, Volume, Automobiles & Transport, Monthly, CAAM - China Association of Automobile Manufacturers
aCNEXSPECP.meaning: Monthly volume of Chinese special purpose vehicle exports (unit count), published by CAAM. China's SPV exports have grown rapidly — from under 20,000 units/year in 2015 to over 60,000 units/year in 2023 — driven by competitive pricing, strong service networks in Africa and Middle East, and BRI-linked procurement. The electric SPV transition is beginning with electric refuse vehicles and electric street sweepers entering export markets.
aCNEXSPECP.how_to_use: Monthly SPV export volumes above 5,000 units represent a strong cycle, typically correlating with elevated global commodity prices (driving mining-related SPV demand), strong BRI project activity, or regional infrastructure stimulus (Gulf capex cycles). Seasonal patterns are present — H1 is typically stronger than H2 as annual procurement tenders close. A dip below 3,000 units/month signals either emerging-market financing constraints or a lull in BRI disbursements.

aCNEXTOWIA.description: Motor Vehicles, Exports, Towing vehicles, Current Prices, Automobiles & Transport, Monthly, CAAM - China Association of Automobile Manufacturers
aCNEXTOWIA.meaning: Monthly value of Chinese towing vehicle exports (tractors, semi-truck tractor units) in current CNY prices, published by CAAM. Towing vehicles (牵引车) are semi-truck tractor heads without trailers — the prime mover in articulated truck combinations. China exports tractor units primarily to Africa, Middle East, Southeast Asia, and Central Asia. Howo, Dongfeng, and FAW are the dominant exporters in this category.
aCNEXTOWIA.how_to_use: Towing vehicle export value is a proxy for China's heavy-truck export competitiveness globally. Divide by aCNEXTOWIP (volume) for average tractor ASP — typically CNY 300,000-500,000/unit for export-grade tractors. Rising tractor unit export values alongside stable volumes indicate premiumisation (LNG tractors replacing diesel, automatic transmissions, driver assistance features). LNG-powered tractor exports are growing rapidly as Africa and Middle East markets electrify their long-haul fleets with cleaner Chinese alternatives to European brands.

aCNEXTOWIP.description: Motor Vehicles, Exports, Towing vehicles, Volume, Automobiles & Transport, Monthly, CAAM - China Association of Automobile Manufacturers
aCNEXTOWIP.meaning: Monthly volume of Chinese towing vehicle (tractor unit) exports in unit count, published by CAAM. China is now the world's largest exporter of heavy tractor units, having displaced European brands (Volvo, DAF, MAN) in most developing markets. Annual tractor unit exports exceeded 100,000 units in 2023. Key markets: Saudi Arabia (post-Vision 2030 logistics build-out), South Africa, Nigeria, Southeast Asia, Russia (post-Western brand exit).
aCNEXTOWIP.how_to_use: Monthly tractor unit exports above 9,000 units signal a strong emerging-market heavy logistics investment cycle. Russia became a major destination after 2022 (Western OEMs exited), accounting for an estimated 20-25% of Chinese tractor unit exports; watch for any geopolitical normalization reducing Russia demand. The electric tractor unit revolution is just beginning for exports — domestic Chinese electric semi-trucks (BYD T9, XCMG XGA4180) are entering export catalogues but ICE remains 95%+ of export volume.

aCNEXTRUCA.description: Motor Vehicles, Exports, Trucks, Current Prices, Automobiles & Transport, Monthly, CAAM - China Association of Automobile Manufacturers
aCNEXTRUCA.meaning: Monthly total value of Chinese truck exports (all types: dump, towing, special, medium, light) in current CNY prices, published by CAAM. This is the broadest commercial vehicle export value aggregate. Chinese truck exports totalled approximately CNY 150 billion in value in 2023. SAIC (Howo brand), Dongfeng, FAW, Foton, and CNHTC (Sinotruk) are China's top truck export groups.
aCNEXTRUCA.how_to_use: This aggregate is the primary headline for China's commercial vehicle export competitiveness. A monthly value sustainably above CNY 13 billion implies a CNY 150B+ annualised truck export run-rate — world-leading. Monitor the ASP trend (aCNEXTRUCA / aCNMVEXTRU) — a rising ASP reflects mix shift toward heavier trucks and premium specifications. China's truck export market faces increasing anti-dumping risk from destination countries (India imposed duties on Chinese trucks in 2023); watch for geographic concentration risk.

aCNMVEXTRU.description: Motor Vehicles, Exports, Trucks, Volume, Automobiles & Transport, Monthly, CAAM - China Association of Automobile Manufacturers
aCNMVEXTRU.meaning: Monthly volume of Chinese truck exports (all types, unit count), published by CAAM. China exported approximately 550,000-600,000 trucks annually by 2023-2024, making it the world's largest commercial vehicle exporter by volume. This figure encompasses light trucks, medium trucks, heavy-duty trucks, tractor units, and dump trucks. The export share of domestic truck production is approximately 15-18%.
aCNMVEXTRU.how_to_use: Monthly truck export volumes above 45,000 units indicate a strong export cycle. A YoY growth rate above 15% is exceptional — cross with individual market data to identify whether growth is broad-based (favourable global cycle) or concentrated (e.g., Russia substitution effect). The electric truck export transition is worth tracking: Chinese OEMs are now beginning to export battery-electric medium trucks to ASEAN and Latin America, where lower charging infrastructure barriers exist compared to long-haul routes.

aCNIMPBUSA.description: Motor Vehicles, Imports, Buses, Current Prices, Automobiles & Transport, Monthly, CAAM - China Association of Automobile Manufacturers
aCNIMPBUSA.meaning: Monthly value of bus imports into China in current CNY prices, published by CAAM. Bus imports to China are extremely limited — China's domestic bus industry (Yutong, BYD, King Long) fully serves domestic demand and is globally cost-competitive. Import volumes are negligible and typically represent specialist luxury coaches or very specific technical categories not produced domestically.
aCNIMPBUSA.how_to_use: Expect near-zero values for this series in normal conditions — China does not meaningfully import buses. Any sustained value above CNY 50 million/month would be anomalous and worth investigating (potential reclassification, luxury motor coach imports, or a specific government fleet purchase). This series is most useful as a data-completeness check: it should be close to zero, and if it is not, that signals either unusual procurement or data classification issues.

aCNMVIMBUS.description: Motor Vehicles, Imports, Buses, Volume, Automobiles & Transport, Monthly, CAAM - China Association of Automobile Manufacturers
aCNMVIMBUS.meaning: Monthly volume of bus imports into China (unit count), published by CAAM. Given China's complete domestic bus manufacturing self-sufficiency, bus import volumes are structurally near zero — typically under 50 units/month nationally and often in single digits. Published on CAAM's standard 2-3 week post-month-end release schedule as part of the comprehensive import/export data package.
aCNMVIMBUS.how_to_use: This series' primary value is as a control check: zero or near-zero readings confirm that China's domestic bus industry is fully import-substituted, a useful baseline for cross-country comparisons. Any sustained increase should be cross-checked against luxury motor coach market data (imported European luxury coaches, e.g., Setra, Neoplan) — the only realistic import bus segment in China. Bus import volumes will remain negligible regardless of market conditions.

aCNIMCHWEA.description: Motor Vehicles, Imports, By Type, Chassis with engine, Current Prices, Automobiles & Transport, Monthly, CAAM - China Association of Automobile Manufacturers
aCNIMCHWEA.meaning: Monthly value of chassis-with-engine imports into China in current CNY prices, published by CAAM. This is a specialist category — China imports chassis primarily for high-specification superstructure applications where foreign chassis (e.g., Mercedes Actros, MAN TGX, Volvo FH) are perceived superior in specific niches such as luxury motorhome chassis, airport ground support equipment, or specialist fire apparatus. Volumes and values are small.
aCNIMCHWEA.how_to_use: Compare with aCNMVIMCHA (volume) for average import chassis ASP — expected to be very high (CNY 500,000-2,000,000+) given that only premium-niche chassis are imported. This series indicates whether China's domestic chassis manufacturers (FAW, SAIC, Dongfeng) have fully captured the high-end chassis market or whether residual import demand persists in premium niches. A declining trend confirms domestic chassis substitution even at the top of the quality spectrum.

aCNMVIMCHA.description: Motor Vehicles, Imports, By Type, Chassis with engine, Volume, Automobiles & Transport, Monthly, CAAM - China Association of Automobile Manufacturers
aCNMVIMCHA.meaning: Monthly volume of chassis-with-engine imports into China (unit count), published by CAAM. Volume data, combined with aCNIMCHWEA value data, gives the average imported chassis price. Monthly volumes are typically in the hundreds or low thousands, serving specialist niches where imported chassis capability or brand prestige is specifically required. Declining trend over time reflects domestic chassis quality improvement.
aCNMVIMCHA.how_to_use: Monitor the ratio of chassis imports to chassis exports (aCNMVIMCHA vs aCNMVEXCHE) — China's surplus (exporting far more chassis than it imports) confirms the structural net export position. The import/export chassis value ratio provides an implicit quality premium: if Chinese chassis exports at CNY 200,000/unit while importing at CNY 800,000/unit, that reflects a quality tier gap in the specialist segment that is narrowing over time.

aCNIMCARRA.description: Motor Vehicles, Imports, Cars (including spare parts), Current Prices, Automobiles & Transport, Monthly, CAAM - China Association of Automobile Manufacturers
aCNIMCARRA.meaning: Monthly value of passenger car imports into China (including spare parts) in current CNY prices, published by CAAM. China imports approximately 800,000-1,000,000 passenger cars annually, predominantly premium and luxury brands: BMW, Mercedes-Benz, Porsche, Audi (models not locally assembled), Lexus, and Land Rover. Import value is significant — approximately CNY 300-400 billion annually — reflecting the high ASP of imported vehicles.
aCNIMCARRA.how_to_use: Divide by aCNIMCARRP (volume) to compute average imported car ASP — typically CNY 300,000-500,000/unit, confirming the luxury-skew of China's import market. Rising import ASP alongside stable or falling import volumes signals that China's import market is concentrating into ultra-luxury (Porsche Cayenne, Mercedes GLS, BMW X5 not locally assembled). The primary risk: as Chinese premium brands (Hongqi, BYD Yangwang, NIO ET9) improve quality, import luxury car volumes face structural pressure downward.

aCNIMCARRP.description: Motor Vehicles, Imports, Cars (including spare parts), Volume, Automobiles & Transport, Monthly, CAAM - China Association of Automobile Manufacturers
aCNIMCARRP.meaning: Monthly volume of passenger car imports into China (unit count, including spare parts), published by CAAM. China's car import volumes have declined from a peak of ~1.3 million units/year in 2017 to ~700,000-800,000 units in 2024, as more foreign models have shifted to local assembly (JV manufacturing) and as Chinese domestic luxury brands have improved. Premium imports (Porsche, BMW, Rolls-Royce, Lamborghini) and niche models not locally assembled make up the bulk.
aCNIMCARRP.how_to_use: Monthly import volumes below 70,000 units signal a soft luxury demand environment or accelerating substitution by domestic premium Chinese brands. The income effect is strong: import car sales correlate with Shanghai/Beijing high-income household confidence surveys and tier-1 city real estate price trends. A re-acceleration above 90,000 units/month requires either new luxury model launches from European/Japanese OEMs or a strong domestic consumer confidence recovery.

aCNIMCORSA.description: Motor Vehicles, Imports, Cross country vehicles, Current Prices, Automobiles & Transport, Monthly, CAAM - China Association of Automobile Manufacturers
aCNIMCORSA.meaning: Monthly value of imported cross-country/SUV vehicles into China in current CNY prices, published by CAAM. This is the highest-value import vehicle category — imported cross-country vehicles are predominantly premium and luxury SUVs: Porsche Cayenne, BMW X5/X7, Mercedes GLE/GLS, Land Rover Defender (UK-built), and Lexus RX/GX. Average import values per unit significantly exceed sedans due to the luxury segment concentration.
aCNIMCORSA.how_to_use: The ASP from aCNIMCORSA / aCNIMCORSP (typically CNY 400,000-700,000) is the best indicator of luxury SUV market health in China. A declining ASP trend signals either (a) more mass-market SUVs being imported rather than pure luxury, or (b) pricing discounting by luxury OEMs responding to Chinese premium brand competition. Cross with monthly Porsche/BMW/Mercedes China delivery data — imported luxury SUV value trends usually confirm or lead dealer-level brand performance by 2-4 weeks.

aCNIMCORSP.description: Motor Vehicles, Imports, Cross country vehicles, Volume, Automobiles & Transport, Monthly, CAAM - China Association of Automobile Manufacturers
aCNIMCORSP.meaning: Monthly volume of imported cross-country/SUV vehicles into China (unit count), published by CAAM. Imported luxury SUVs peaked at approximately 300,000-350,000 units annually in China around 2019-2021 and have since declined as JV localisation expanded (BMW X5 PHEV now locally made in Shenyang) and Chinese luxury SUV brands improved. The residual import market is concentrated in models not available locally — ultra-premium and flagship SUVs.
aCNIMCORSP.how_to_use: Monthly import SUV volumes below 25,000 units indicate a soft luxury market or aggressive JV localisation reducing import dependency. Compare with domestic cross-country SUV sales (aCNCNOAVBM, aCNCNBNUVP) — when locally made SUV growth accelerates alongside import SUV decline, it confirms the JV localisation trend is cannibalising imports. The ratio of imported to domestically made premium SUV is a useful indicator of foreign OEM China strategy (import-led vs. JV-local).

aCNIMDUMPA.description: Motor Vehicles, Imports, Dump trucks, Current Prices, Automobiles & Transport, Monthly, CAAM - China Association of Automobile Manufacturers
aCNIMDUMPA.meaning: Monthly value of dump truck imports into China in current CNY prices, published by CAAM. China is a net exporter of dump trucks by a very large margin — its domestic manufacturers (Howo, Dongfeng) are globally price-competitive and technologically capable. Dump truck imports into China are negligible in normal conditions, limited to specialty mining applications (ultra-large haul trucks above 200 tonnes from Caterpillar, Komatsu, Liebherr) not produced domestically at commercial scale.
aCNIMDUMPA.how_to_use: Near-zero values are expected for this series. A rising import value signals either (a) a specific large mining project requiring ultra-large haul trucks from foreign OEMs, or (b) data reclassification. Cross with China's domestic mining capex data — if large open-pit copper or coal mines are commissioning new fleets, a temporary spike in ultra-large truck imports is consistent with construction-phase equipment procurement. The structural trend is toward domestic ultra-large truck substitution (CRRC and others developing 200T+ electric haul trucks).

aCNIMDUMPP.description: Motor Vehicles, Imports, Dump trucks, Volume, Automobiles & Transport, Monthly, CAAM - China Association of Automobile Manufacturers
aCNIMDUMPP.meaning: Monthly volume of dump truck imports into China (unit count), published by CAAM. Volume data is typically negligible — typically zero to single-digit units per month for the ultra-large mining dump truck niche. Any reading above 10 units in a single month is notable and worth investigating as a potential large project-related procurement event.
aCNIMDUMPP.how_to_use: When volume is near zero, the ASP implied (aCNIMDUMPA / aCNIMDUMPP) will be extremely high — consistent with ultra-large Caterpillar 793 or Komatsu 930E mining trucks priced at USD 3-5 million each. Use this as a spot-check: if the implied unit price is in this range, the data is internally consistent. If volume is non-trivial (50+ units/month), it would signal an unusual procurement event requiring further investigation.

aCNIMNONSA.description: Motor Vehicles, Imports, Not specified manned vehicles, Current Prices, Automobiles & Transport, Monthly, CAAM - China Association of Automobile Manufacturers
aCNIMNONSA.subcategory: Vehicle Imports — Not Specified Manned Vehicles (Value)
aCNIMNONSA.meaning: Monthly value of imports of not-specified manned vehicles into China in current CNY prices, published by CAAM. This residual import category captures manned vehicle types that do not fall into defined buckets — similar to the export equivalent but on the import side. Monthly values are typically very small, reflecting niche specialist imports.
aCNIMNONSA.how_to_use: As with the export equivalent (aCNEXNONSA), this series functions primarily as a residual and data-quality reference. The key application is ensuring the sum of all vehicle import sub-categories reconciles to total vehicle import data. Large unexplained values here may indicate customs classification disputes or new vehicle types entering the market for which classification codes are not yet standardised (e.g., autonomous shuttle imports).

aCNIMNONSP.description: Motor Vehicles, Imports, Not specified manned vehicles, Volume, Automobiles & Transport, Monthly, CAAM - China Association of Automobile Manufacturers
aCNIMNONSP.subcategory: Vehicle Imports — Not Specified Manned Vehicles (Volume)
aCNIMNONSP.meaning: Monthly volume of not-specified manned vehicle imports into China (unit count), published by CAAM. As with the value series, volumes are typically very low. This is the import-side counterpart to aCNEXNONSP, and the same analytical framework applies — check ASP consistency and use as a data-reconciliation series.
aCNIMNONSP.how_to_use: Monthly readings near zero are expected. If volumes increase materially (above 500 units/month), investigate whether a new vehicle type or market entrant is causing classification overflow into this residual bucket. Cross-check against Chinese customs general administration (GACC) HS code 87.03-87.05 data for classification cross-validation. Treat any volume-value combination implying an ASP below CNY 30,000 or above CNY 2,000,000 as a data quality flag.

aCNIMOTHEA.description: Motor Vehicles, Imports, Other manned vehicles, Current Prices, Automobiles & Transport, Monthly, CAAM - China Association of Automobile Manufacturers
aCNIMOTHEA.meaning: Monthly value of other manned vehicle imports into China in current CNY prices, published by CAAM. Similar to the export equivalent, this 'other' category captures atypical manned vehicle imports — which in the Chinese import context likely includes recreational vehicles (RVs/motorhomes), camper vans, and luxury motor coaches from European manufacturers (Niesmann+Bischoff, Hymer, Adria) that are not classified as standard buses.
aCNIMOTHEA.how_to_use: The RV/motorhome niche is growing in China — China's domestic RV market grew from near-zero in 2015 to over 100,000 RVs on road by 2024. Imported European motorhomes (ASP CNY 500,000-2,000,000+) represent the premium segment. Monitor this series for signs of RV import growth as a proxy for China's emerging camping and outdoor recreation economy. Cross with domestic Chinese RV production data for the import vs. domestic substitution ratio in this lifestyle segment.

aCNIMOTHEP.description: Motor Vehicles, Imports, Other manned vehicles, Volume, Automobiles & Transport, Monthly, CAAM - China Association of Automobile Manufacturers
aCNIMOTHEP.meaning: Monthly volume of other manned vehicle imports into China (unit count), published by CAAM. If this series predominantly captures imported motorhomes and luxury coaches, monthly volumes will be in the hundreds — consistent with a niche premium import market.
