Published on standard CAAM schedule approximately 2-3 weeks after month-end.
aCNIMOTHEP.how_to_use: Compute ASP as aCNIMOTHEA / aCNIMOTHEP — if implied ASP is CNY 500,000-1,500,000, the mix is consistent with European motorhome imports; if ASP is lower (CNY 100,000-300,000), it may include smaller imported recreational micro-vehicles or camper vans. Monitor for YoY volume growth above 20% as a signal that China's recreational vehicle import market is entering mainstream growth, with implications for European RV manufacturers' China revenue.

aCNIMTOWIA.description: Motor Vehicles, Imports, Towing vehicles, Current Prices, Automobiles & Transport, Monthly, CAAM - China Association of Automobile Manufacturers
aCNIMTOWIA.meaning: Monthly value of towing vehicle (semi-truck tractor unit) imports into China in current CNY prices, published by CAAM. Similar to dump trucks, China is a net exporter of tractor units and domestic production satisfies all mainstream demand. Imports are limited to ultra-premium European tractor units (Volvo FH, Scania R-series, Mercedes Actros) purchased for prestige fleet applications or specific technical requirements such as heavy-haul specialist logistics.
aCNIMTOWIA.how_to_use: Near-zero values are expected. Any monthly value exceeding CNY 100 million likely reflects a concentrated tender purchase of European heavy-haul tractors by a major logistics operator or state-owned enterprise. The implied ASP (typically CNY 800,000-1,500,000/unit for imported European tractors vs. CNY 300,000-400,000 for equivalent Chinese) illustrates the quality premium that has historically justified imports — a premium that is narrowing as Chinese OEMs improve their top-specification products.

aCNIMTOWIP.description: Motor Vehicles, Imports, Towing vehicles, Volume, Automobiles & Transport, Monthly, CAAM - China Association of Automobile Manufacturers
aCNIMTOWIP.meaning: Monthly volume of towing vehicle (tractor unit) imports into China (unit count), published by CAAM. Volumes are structurally very low — typically below 200 units/month — reflecting the near-complete import substitution of Chinese domestic tractor-unit manufacturers. Published as part of the comprehensive CAAM monthly import/export data release.
aCNIMTOWIP.how_to_use: When combined with aCNIMTOWIA, the implied ASP for imported tractor units (CNY 800,000+) reflects the remaining quality premium that foreign brands command in China's specialist heavy-haul segment. Track the trend: if imported tractor unit volumes decline from 100 to under 20 per month, it confirms that Chinese premium tractor units (FAW J7, Dongfeng Tianlong flagship) have effectively eliminated the residual import demand even at the top tier. This is a useful indicator of Chinese commercial vehicle brand equity progression.

aCNIMTRUKA.description: Motor Vehicles, Imports, Trucks, Current Prices, Automobiles & Transport, Monthly, CAAM - China Association of Automobile Manufacturers
aCNIMTRUKA.meaning: Monthly total value of truck imports into China (all types) in current CNY prices, published by CAAM. China's total truck import value is structurally low and declining — domestic brands satisfy all commercial segments, and imported trucks are limited to ultra-premium or specialist niches. The aggregate rarely exceeds CNY 500 million/month, and often falls below CNY 200 million — representing less than 0.2% of China's domestic truck market by value.
aCNIMTRUKA.how_to_use: The import/export ratio for trucks (aCNIMTRUKA vs. aCNEXTRUCA) is perhaps the starkest illustration of China's commercial vehicle industry transformation — from net importer in the 1990s to dominant net exporter today. A sustained import value of under CNY 300 million/month against exports of CNY 12+ billion/month gives a ratio of approximately 1:40, confirming near-complete import substitution. Use this ratio as a benchmark indicator of industrial policy success in the truck sector.

aCNMVIMTRU.description: Motor Vehicles, Imports, Trucks, Volume, Automobiles & Transport, Monthly, CAAM - China Association of Automobile Manufacturers
aCNMVIMTRU.meaning: Monthly volume of truck imports into China (all types, unit count), published by CAAM. Volumes are structurally low — typically 200-500 units/month nationally across all truck types — reflecting China's near-complete domestic truck manufacturing self-sufficiency. Monthly data provides the volume denominator for computing average import truck ASP when combined with aCNIMTRUKA.
aCNMVIMTRU.how_to_use: The implied ASP from aCNIMTRUKA / aCNMVIMTRU is typically CNY 600,000-1,200,000/unit, confirming that China's residual truck imports are exclusively premium-specialist vehicles (Caterpillar ultra-large haul trucks, Liebherr speciality, European premium long-haul tractors). Trend analysis: any quarterly decline in both volume and value is consistent with continued domestic substitution even at the top of the quality spectrum. Cross with Chinese OEM product announcements for new flagship products targeting the residual import niche.

aCNPDAUTO.meaning: Monthly total automobile production in China (all types, all powertrains), published by NBS (National Bureau of Statistics) and cross-verified by CAAM, released approximately 2-3 weeks after month-end. This is the supply-side headline for the world's largest auto market. China's total vehicle production was approximately 30.2 million units in 2023 and 31.3 million in 2024, of which NEVs represented approximately 35% and 48% respectively.
aCNPDAUTO.how_to_use: Compare with aCNDSLSAUT (domestic sales) and aCNEXCARRP (export volume) to compute implied inventory change: Production - Domestic Sales - Exports = Inventory Change. A sustained positive inventory build of more than 200,000 units/month is a leading indicator of OEM production cuts within 1-3 months. Monthly production above 2.7 million units (annualised 32M+) signals capacity utilisation pressure; below 2.4 million signals demand-side caution. Cross with steel, aluminium, and semiconductor import data as production-corroborating supply chain signals.

aCNMVPCVEHT.description: Motor Vehicles, Production, Commercial vehicles, total
aCNMVPCVEHT.meaning: Monthly total commercial vehicle production in China (trucks, buses, special purpose, all powertrains), published by NBS/CAAM approximately 2-3 weeks post-month-end. China's commercial vehicle production totalled approximately 4.5-5.0 million units annually in 2023-2024. Commercial vehicles include heavy/medium/light trucks, dump trucks, tractor units, and buses. The segment is highly cyclical, tracking infrastructure investment and freight demand.
aCNMVPCVEHT.how_to_use: Commercial vehicle production is one of the best leading indicators of China's investment cycle — heavy truck production in particular leads fixed asset investment by 2-3 months. A monthly commercial vehicle output above 430,000 units signals a strong investment/freight environment; below 350,000 signals cyclical weakness. The electrification of commercial vehicles is a key theme: electric light-commercial vehicles (vans, couriers) are being adopted rapidly in Chinese cities while heavy truck electrification trails passenger EVs by 3-5 years.

aCNCNDTFCM.description: Multi-purpose passenger car (MPV) production, domestic manufacturing, 2.5 liters < ≤ 3.0 liters
aCNCNDTFCM.meaning: Monthly production of domestically manufactured multi-purpose passenger vehicles (MPVs) with 2.5–3.0 litre engine displacement, published by CAAM. MPVs (多功能乘用车) in China include family minivans, business-class people-carriers (Buick GL8, Honda Odyssey), and luxury van-style vehicles. The 2.5–3.0L displacement band captures premium business MPVs used extensively as executive transport in China's corporate sector.
aCNCNDTFCM.how_to_use: Premium MPV production (2.5–3.0L) is a proxy for corporate executive transport demand, closely tied to business travel activity and corporate entertainment spending. The Buick GL8 (GM-SAIC JV) dominates this segment with 50%+ market share — monitor this series for GL8 production volume changes as a proxy for GM China's JV performance. Growing competition from Chinese luxury MPVs (DENZA D9, Xpeng X9, BYD Yangwang) will put JV dominance under pressure starting 2025.

aCNCNCKPAP.description: Multi-purpose passenger car (MPV) sales, domestic manufacturing, 2.5 liters < ≤ 3.0 liters
aCNCNCKPAP.meaning: Monthly sales of domestically manufactured MPVs in the 2.5–3.0 litre displacement band, published by CAAM at irregular (not strictly monthly) frequency. This sales series is the demand-side counterpart to aCNCNDTFCM production. Business-class MPV sales in China total approximately 400,000-500,000 units annually, with the Buick GL8 accounting for 200,000+ units. Chinese NEV MPVs (DENZA D9 by BYD, >CNY 300,000) entered this segment competitively from 2022.
aCNCNCKPAP.how_to_use: When this sales series diverges significantly from aCNCNDTFCM production (sales >> production), it signals a supply-constrained hot market. Conversely, rising production with flat sales indicates dealer stock build. The entry of BYD DENZA D9 and Xpeng X9 NEV MPVs is directly attacking the incumbent GL8/Odyssey ICE dominance — monitor whether this series declines YoY even as total MPV sales grow, which would confirm ICE MPV displacement by NEVs.

aCNCNDLPAM.description: Multi-purpose passenger car (MPV) sales, domestic manufacturing, 2.5 liters < ≤ 3.0 liters
aCNCNDLPAM.meaning: A second CAAM monthly series for domestically manufactured MPV sales in the 2.5–3.0 litre band, likely representing a different OEM line or body-type sub-classification within the same displacement range. Published on standard 2-3 week CAAM post-month-end schedule.
aCNCNDLPAM.how_to_use: Aggregate aCNCNCKPAP and aCNCNDLPAM for the complete picture of premium domestic MPV sales. The combined figure cross-referenced against Buick GL8 monthly sales data (reported by SAIC separately) allows isolation of non-GL8 premium MPV performance — the segment where Chinese premium brands are gaining fastest. Any month where the combined non-GL8 MPV total approaches or exceeds GL8 volume signals a structural competitive shift in China's most stable JV-dominated segment.

aCNCNGWHJM.meaning: Quarterly production of heavy multi-purpose trucks (大型多功能卡车) in China, published by CAAM at P3M (quarterly) frequency. Heavy multi-purpose trucks are capable of multiple specialist roles — flatbed heavy haulage, oversized load transport, crane-equipped heavy transport. This is a small but high-value segment. Quarterly reporting reflects the limited production volumes and specialist procurement nature of this vehicle class.
aCNCNGWHJM.how_to_use: Quarterly frequency limits this to strategic trend analysis. Heavy multi-purpose truck production tracking infrastructure mega-project activity — large quarterly spikes often correspond to specific large infrastructure project awards (high-speed rail, nuclear power, bridge construction). Cross with Ministry of Transport project announcement data. The electric and hydrogen versions of heavy multi-purpose trucks are in development but still at prototype stage, so ICE dominates this series entirely.

aCNCNEFWEM.description: Natural gas basic passenger car (sedan) production, domestic manufacturing
aCNCNEFWEM.meaning: Monthly production of domestically manufactured CNG (compressed natural gas) basic passenger sedans, published by CAAM. CNG passenger cars are a niche transitional technology in China — more common in taxi fleets and ride-hailing than in private ownership due to refuelling infrastructure limitations. Monthly production volumes are typically in the hundreds to low thousands, declining as BEV and PHEV alternatives become more cost-competitive.
aCNCNEFWEM.how_to_use: CNG sedan production is a structural decline story: falling natural gas vehicle output alongside rising NEV output confirms the technology pathway to electrification rather than gas. A temporary spike in CNG sedan production may coincide with a local government taxi fleet renewal using CNG (common in cities with gas distribution infrastructure but limited charging). Cross with aCNCNLAM (CNG sedan sales) to verify market take-up of any production increase.

aCNCNLAM.description: Natural gas basic passenger car (sedan) sales volume, domestic manufacturing
aCNCNLAM.meaning: Monthly sales volume of domestically manufactured CNG basic passenger sedans, published by CAAM. CNG sedan sales track taxi-fleet procurement cycles and ride-hailing operator fleet renewal decisions. With approximately 1.5 million CNG-fuelled taxis and ride-hailing vehicles on Chinese roads, fleet replacement creates recurring but irregular sales patterns. Published on standard 2-3 week CAAM release schedule.
aCNCNLAM.how_to_use: Compare aCNCNLAM (sales) with aCNCNEFWEM (production) — a consistently positive production-sales gap would signal accumulating inventory, likely indicating CNG demand is softening faster than OEMs anticipated. As BEV taxi economics improve (total cost of ownership below CNG at CNY 0.35-0.50/km electric vs. CNY 0.45-0.60/km CNG), fleet operators increasingly choose electric on renewal — a structural headwind for this series. Monitor taxi electrification policies from major cities.

aCNCNOHAAM.description: Natural gas bus non-complete vehicle sales, medium
aCNCNOHAAM.meaning: Monthly sales of non-complete (chassis/base vehicle) medium CNG buses in China, published by CAAM. Non-complete CNG bus sales serve transit operators and coachbuilders who require CNG-powered base vehicles for customisation. Medium CNG buses (8-10 metres) are widely used in urban transit, interurban routes, and as school buses. This segment is being displaced by electric equivalents at a rapid pace.
aCNCNOHAAM.how_to_use: Medium CNG bus non-complete vehicle sales are declining as city bus operators shift to BEV (battery electric) alternatives mandated by China's new-energy public transit policies. A sustained monthly reading above 1,000 units suggests some cities/regions are still procuring CNG buses due to charging infrastructure gaps or budget constraints favouring lower-upfront-cost CNG. Cross with BEV bus production data to compute the technology substitution rate in the medium bus segment.

aCNCNHXSTM.description: Natural gas passenger car non-complete vehicle production, light weight
aCNCNHXSTM.meaning: Quarterly production of light-weight CNG passenger car non-complete vehicles (base vehicles/chassis), published by CAAM at P3M frequency. Non-complete vehicles in this context are base platforms for body-builders creating custom passenger carriers (airport shuttles, hotel transfer vehicles, special-use minibuses) running on CNG. Quarterly reporting reflects the low and irregular volumes in this specialist niche.
aCNCNHXSTM.how_to_use: Quarterly frequency limits timely analysis. The light CNG non-complete vehicle segment is being squeezed from both ends: electric light buses are replacing it from above (better economics for city use) and larger CNG buses from below (better economics for interurban use). Use rolling 4-quarter totals to smooth the lumpy quarterly data. Any sustained quarterly reading above 5,000 units signals a specific fleet procurement wave; below 2,000 units confirms structural decline.

aCNCNGRWBM.description: Natural gas passenger car non-complete vehicle production, medium
aCNCNGRWBM.meaning: Monthly production of medium CNG passenger car non-complete vehicles, published by CAAM. Medium-sized CNG non-complete passenger vehicles serve as the base platform for medium-format people-movers (12-20 seats) used in hotel shuttles, corporate transport, scenic area transit, and rural public transport routes where CNG refuelling infrastructure exists.
aCNCNGRWBM.how_to_use: Monthly production in this segment is typically 1,000-5,000 units in periods of active CNG fleet renewal, and below 500 units in weak demand environments. The geographic distribution of CNG refuelling infrastructure determines demand — cities in western China (Sichuan, Xinjiang) with strong natural gas distribution networks support more residual CNG bus demand than coastal cities with mature electric charging infrastructure. Cross with provincial CNG infrastructure investment data.

aCNCNKEREM.description: Natural gas sports multi-purpose passenger vehicle (SUV) production, CKD, four-wheel drive
aCNCNKEREM.meaning: Monthly production of CKD-assembled, four-wheel-drive CNG sports utility vehicles (SUVs), published by CAAM. CNG-powered CKD SUVs represent an intersection of two niche segments: CKD assembly (partially imported kit) and CNG powertrain. This is an extremely small segment likely covering specific JV models adapted for CNG in regions with strong natural gas distribution.
aCNCNKEREM.how_to_use: This is a specialist niche with very low volume — likely tens of units per month. Given the simultaneous decline of CNG passenger vehicles and the growth of BEV/PHEV SUVs, this segment represents a transitional technology that will likely approach zero production within 2-3 years. Monitor it primarily as a confirmation signal that CNG passenger vehicle phaseout is proceeding at the segment level. Aggregate with companion CNG SUV CKD RICs (aCNCNFXOBM, aCNCNNPHUM) for the total CKD CNG 4WD SUV picture.

aCNCNFXOBM.description: Natural gas sports multi-purpose passenger vehicle (SUV) production, CKD, four-wheel drive
aCNCNFXOBM.meaning: Second CAAM monthly series for CKD-assembled, four-wheel-drive CNG SUV production. As with aCNCNKEREM, this covers a separate OEM line producing the same class of vehicle. Published on standard 2-3 week CAAM post-month-end schedule. CNG 4WD CKD SUV production is a waning niche as NEVs displace gas-vehicle alternatives across all passenger car segments.
aCNCNFXOBM.how_to_use: Aggregate with aCNCNKEREM and aCNCNNPHUM for total CKD CNG 4WD SUV production. The combined figure peaking and then declining is a textbook technology displacement curve — use it as a case study in how NEV substitution works through the powertrain mix at the sub-segment level. For practitioners, this means the CNG SUV production series adds value primarily as a proxy for specific JV models' production volume, useful for JV partner performance tracking.

aCNCNNPHUM.description: Natural gas sports multi-purpose passenger vehicle (SUV) production, CKD, four-wheel drive
aCNCNNPHUM.meaning: Third CAAM monthly series for CKD-assembled, four-wheel-drive CNG SUV production. Standard CAAM release within 2-3 weeks of month-end. Three separate RICs for this sub-category reflect CAAM's granular tracking of individual OEM production lines even in very low-volume segments.
aCNCNNPHUM.how_to_use: Use in aggregate with aCNCNKEREM and aCNCNFXOBM. If any individual line (one RIC) shows persistently zero production while the others show low positive volumes, it likely signals that a specific OEM has already discontinued its CNG SUV CKD production — a useful data point for tracking which JV partners are exiting the CNG market first. This sort of exit-signal tracking is valuable for CNG infrastructure suppliers (filling station operators, compressor manufacturers).

aCNCNIPKJM.description: Natural gas sports multi-purpose passenger vehicle (SUV) production, CKD, two-wheel drive
aCNCNIPKJM.meaning: Monthly production of CKD-assembled, two-wheel-drive CNG SUVs, published by CAAM. The 2WD variant is structurally more common in this niche than 4WD — urban CNG SUV buyers do not typically require 4WD capability, and 2WD is cheaper. Monthly volumes are tiny (single digits to tens) and declining as NEVs substitute.
aCNCNIPKJM.how_to_use: Aggregate with aCNCNEEOCM and aCNCNNYFSM for total CKD 2WD CNG SUV production. The substitution pressure here is particularly acute: BYD's Song PHEV and EV variants offer superior performance to CNG SUVs at lower operating costs with plug-in convenience. Any sustained production above 50 units/month for this combined CKD 2WD CNG SUV segment signals CNG is holding on in specific geographic niches (likely Sichuan/Chongqing where CNG infrastructure is most developed).

aCNCNEEOCM.description: Natural gas sports multi-purpose passenger vehicle (SUV) production, CKD, two-wheel drive
aCNCNEEOCM.meaning: Second CAAM monthly series for CKD-assembled, two-wheel-drive CNG SUV production. As with other CNG SUV sub-series, this tracks a specific OEM line in a rapidly declining niche segment. Published on standard CAAM schedule. Monthly volumes are typically in single digits.
aCNCNEEOCM.how_to_use: Use in aggregate. When this and companion CNG CKD 2WD SUV series all converge to zero simultaneously, it marks the effective end of CKD CNG SUV production in China — a significant milestone for the natural gas vehicle industry. The timing of this endpoint (expected 2026-2028 based on current trajectory) is relevant for CNG station operators planning investment in passenger vehicle refuelling capacity.

aCNCNNYFSM.description: Natural gas sports multi-purpose passenger vehicle (SUV) production, CKD, two-wheel drive
aCNCNNYFSM.meaning: Third CAAM series for CKD-assembled two-wheel-drive CNG SUV production; published at irregular frequency (the JSON notes frequency as blank for this RIC). The blank frequency likely reflects extremely sporadic production — this line may only produce vehicles in specific quarters when a government or fleet tender is active, rather than on a continuous basis.
aCNCNNYFSM.how_to_use: Treat as a spot/event-driven series rather than a continuous trend series. Any non-zero reading signals a specific fleet procurement event for CNG SUVs. For time-series modelling purposes, fill missing periods with zero rather than interpolating. Cross-reference with CAAM annual summaries to verify whether cumulative annual figures are internally consistent with the sporadic monthly readings.

aCNCNLAQWM.description: Natural gas sports multi-purpose passenger vehicle (SUV) production, domestic manufacturing, four wheel drive
aCNCNLAQWM.meaning: Monthly production of domestically manufactured (non-CKD) four-wheel-drive CNG SUVs, published by CAAM. Domestic manufacture of CNG SUVs uses locally sourced CNG drivetrains and bodies — qualifying for domestic content incentives. This segment serves similar markets to the CKD equivalent but with a localisation advantage. Monthly volumes are in the low hundreds at most.
aCNCNLAQWM.how_to_use: Compare domestic vs. CKD production ratios for CNG 4WD SUVs (aCNCNLAQWM + aCNCNMBJOM vs. aCNCNKEREM + aCNCNFXOBM + aCNCNNPHUM) — the localisation ratio for CNG vehicles should be higher than for FCEV vehicles given the more mature domestic CNG component supply chain. As this segment declines toward zero overall, the domestic/CKD split will become increasingly volatile and less analytically meaningful.

aCNCNMBJOM.description: Natural gas sports multi-purpose passenger vehicle (SUV) production, domestic manufacturing, four wheel drive
aCNCNMBJOM.meaning: Second CAAM monthly series for domestically manufactured four-wheel-drive CNG SUV production. Published on standard 2-3 week post-month-end schedule. As with other CNG production series, volumes are declining rapidly. This is one of a family of 9 CNG SUV production RICs in this batch, reflecting CAAM's granular OEM-level tracking.
aCNCNMBJOM.how_to_use: Aggregate with aCNCNLAQWM for total domestic 4WD CNG SUV production. The structural decline here mirrors the broader CNG passenger vehicle phase-out but may lag the CKD phase-out if domestic CNG SUVs are primarily deployed in fleet/taxi roles where total-cost-of-ownership calculations still favour CNG in certain regions. Monitor for any government fleet conversion policy that might temporarily sustain this series.

aCNCNMWRGM.description: Natural gas sports multi-purpose passenger vehicle (SUV) production, domestic manufacturing, two-wheel drive
aCNCNMWRGM.meaning: Monthly production of domestically manufactured two-wheel-drive CNG SUVs, published by CAAM. This series completes the CNG SUV production matrix (CKD/Domestic x 4WD/2WD). Domestic 2WD CNG SUVs represent the most accessible CNG SUV variant — lowest cost, domestic localisation, no 4WD premium. Despite these advantages, BEV/PHEV substitution pressure is eliminating the commercial case.
aCNCNMWRGM.how_to_use: The domestic 2WD CNG SUV is the last segment of the CNG passenger SUV market to hold out economically against electrification, because domestic manufacture reduces cost and 2WD avoids the 4WD premium. Watch for the 'last holdout' effect: as 4WD and CKD variants approach zero production, this series may briefly show relative resilience. The endpoint — when this series reaches zero consistently — marks the end of CNG-powered SUV production in China, expected by 2027-2028.

aCNCNIRSBM.meaning: Quarterly production of medium CNG trucks in China, published by CAAM at P3M frequency. Medium CNG trucks (6-14 tonne GVW) are used in urban and suburban freight, particularly in natural gas distribution regions. CNG trucks have lower CO2 than diesel and historically lower fuel costs — but LNG (liquefied natural gas) has largely displaced CNG in long-haul heavy trucks, while electrification is advancing in urban freight.
aCNCNIRSBM.how_to_use: Quarterly data limits tactical use. Medium CNG truck production is a proxy for natural gas infrastructure investment and urban fleet electrification pace: if CNG truck quarterly output remains above 5,000 units, electrification of urban medium freight has not yet reached tipping point in most Chinese cities. Below 2,000 units/quarter signals that electric alternatives (Dongfeng EV van, BYD T5 EV) have sufficiently penetrated the medium urban freight segment to undercut CNG economics.

aCNCNOYPMM.description: Off-road trucks, non-complete vehicle production, light weight
aCNCNOYPMM.meaning: Monthly production of light-weight off-road truck non-complete vehicles (chassis/cab) in China, published by CAAM. Light off-road truck chassis serve applications including agricultural equipment transport, forest/plantation operations, construction site internal haulage, and specialist light utilities. Chinese light off-road truck manufacturers include Foton, JMC, and several Shandong-based specialist makers.
aCNCNOYPMM.how_to_use: Production of light off-road non-complete trucks tracks agricultural mechanisation investment and rural construction activity. Seasonal patterns are strong: peaks in March-May (pre-planting infrastructure) and August-October (harvest logistics). Monthly production above 15,000 units signals healthy rural equipment demand. Electric light off-road trucks are beginning to emerge from Chinese manufacturers targeting forestry and plantation operations where noise reduction and zero-emission requirements apply.

aCNCNARRDM.description: Off-road trucks, non-complete vehicle sales, light weight
aCNCNARRDM.meaning: Monthly sales of light-weight off-road truck non-complete vehicles in China, published by CAAM. The sales counterpart to aCNCNOYPMM production. Off-road truck chassis sales directly reflect dealer and distributor procurement cycles, which lead end-user demand by 4-8 weeks. Customers include agricultural machinery dealers, specialist vehicle body builders, and construction equipment suppliers.
aCNCNARRDM.how_to_use: Compare with aCNCNOYPMM (production) to assess channel inventory dynamics. When sales persistently trail production, distributor stocking is occurring ahead of anticipated seasonal demand — a leading indicator of robust agricultural or construction demand 1-2 months forward. When sales exceed production, it signals drawdown of existing channel inventory, possibly indicating supply constraints from chassis manufacturers. Cross-correlate with NBS rural fixed asset investment quarterly data.

aCNCNERZXM.meaning: Monthly production of ordinary hybrid (non-plug-in HEV) buses in China, published by CAAM. Ordinary hybrid buses use regenerative braking to improve fuel economy (typically 15-20% better than diesel equivalents) but cannot be externally charged. This technology has been largely superseded by plug-in hybrid (PHEV) and pure BEV buses in China's public transit, as the economics of BEV buses became compelling post-2020.
aCNCNERZXM.how_to_use: Ordinary hybrid bus production is a diminishing segment — the technology plateau between diesel and full BEV buses was transitory. By 2024, BEV buses accounted for over 80% of new urban bus procurement in China, leaving ordinary HEV buses relevant only in specific scenarios (cold climates where battery performance degrades). Monitor this series in context with aCNCNGVROM (PHEV bus production) and BEV bus data — together they show the full electrification pathway for China's bus fleet.

aCNCNQHIPM.meaning: Second CAAM monthly series for ordinary hybrid bus production, tracking a separate OEM line from aCNCNERZXM. Published within standard 2-3 weeks of month-end. Multiple RICs for ordinary hybrid bus production reflect CAAM's practice of tracking each major bus manufacturer (Yutong, King Long, Higer, CRRC Electric) separately even in declining technology segments.
aCNCNQHIPM.how_to_use: Aggregate aCNCNERZXM and aCNCNQHIPM for the total ordinary hybrid bus production across all OEMs. Comparing the combined production with aCNCNDXYM (sales) provides an inventory snapshot for this waning technology. If aggregated production significantly exceeds sales, it may indicate OEMs have not yet wound down their HEV bus assembly lines despite weak demand — a potential write-down risk for manufacturers still carrying HEV bus inventory.

aCNCNGXMKM.description: Ordinary hybrid bus production, light weight
aCNCNGXMKM.meaning: Monthly production of light-weight ordinary hybrid buses in China, published by CAAM. Light hybrid buses (typically 6-8 metres) are used in community shuttle services, school bus applications, and rural transit. The lighter class has somewhat different economics than full-size city buses — the smaller battery and motor makes hybrid technology more cost-competitive vs. BEV in this size class.
aCNCNGXMKM.how_to_use: Light-weight ordinary hybrid bus production may prove more durable than full-size equivalents precisely because the BEV alternative is proportionally more expensive at smaller sizes (battery cost scales less favourably with size reduction). Monthly production above 500 units for light hybrid buses suggests this niche is sustainable in the medium term. Cross with school bus sector data — China's school bus upgrade cycle periodically drives light transit bus procurement in waves.

aCNCNDXYM.subcategory: Hybrid Vehicles — Ordinary Hybrid Bus Sales
aCNCNDXYM.meaning: Quarterly sales of ordinary hybrid buses in China, published by CAAM at P3M frequency. Quarterly reporting reflects the declining volume and irregular procurement patterns of this segment. Sales are typically lumpy due to government and city transit operator tender awards, which tend to be annual or semi-annual procurement events rather than continuous monthly purchases.
aCNCNDXYM.how_to_use: Convert to monthly average (÷3) for comparability with quarterly production series. If quarterly sales consistently run below combined quarterly production (aCNCNERZXM + aCNCNQHIPM × 3), the ordinary hybrid bus industry is building channel inventory. A sudden quarterly spike in sales likely corresponds to a specific city transit operator's fleet renewal tender — cross with municipal government procurement announcements for confirmation.

aCNCNEYUMM.subcategory: Hybrid Vehicles — Ordinary Hybrid Commercial Vehicles
aCNCNEYUMM.meaning: Monthly production of ordinary hybrid commercial vehicles (trucks, vans, light commercial) in China, published by CAAM. This broad category captures HEV technology applied to commercial vehicles beyond buses — including delivery vans, light utility trucks, and medium commercial vehicles with mild-hybrid or full-hybrid powertrains. Commercial HEVs offer fuel savings without the range anxiety of BEV alternatives for longer routes.
aCNCNEYUMM.how_to_use: Commercial vehicle HEV adoption is on a different timeline from passenger car NEV adoption in China — total-cost-of-ownership analysis for commercial operators is more rigorous, and the charging infrastructure constraints for heavy-duty cycles make HEVs competitive longer. Monthly commercial HEV production above 5,000 units signals genuine fleet operator adoption beyond niche pilots. Cross with BEV commercial vehicle production data to compute the HEV/BEV share in the commercial segment — a ratio that will narrow as BEV commercial costs fall.

aCNCNGWXOM.description: Ordinary hybrid sport utility vehicle (SUV) production, CKD, four-wheel drive
aCNCNGWXOM.meaning: Monthly production of CKD-assembled, four-wheel-drive ordinary hybrid SUVs in China, published by CAAM. These are predominantly Japanese JV HEV SUVs assembled in China from imported kits — Toyota RAV4 Hybrid (THS system), Honda CR-V e:HEV, and similar. The CKD classification indicates partial import content. Monthly volumes are typically in the range of 5,000-20,000 units for major models.
aCNCNGWXOM.how_to_use: This series closely tracks Japan's JV hybrid SUV fortunes in China. Toyota's THS hybrid system has historically dominated this production segment — a declining trend in aCNCNGWXOM directly reflects Toyota's SUV market share erosion to Chinese PHEV/BEV alternatives. Monitor the CKD/domestic production split: as Japanese brands localise more hybrid content, some volume migrates from CKD series to domestic series. A combined CKD hybrid SUV 4WD decline of more than 20% YoY signals a significant JV hybrid SUV share loss.

aCNCNIUSTM.description: Ordinary hybrid sport utility vehicle (SUV) production, CKD, four-wheel drive
aCNCNIUSTM.meaning: Second CAAM monthly series for CKD-assembled four-wheel-drive ordinary hybrid SUV production, tracking a separate JV OEM line from aCNCNGWXOM. Published on standard 2-3 week CAAM post-month-end schedule. Given the CKD 4WD HEV SUV segment is predominantly Japanese JV (Toyota, Honda, Lexus), two separate RICs here likely correspond to two different JV manufacturing facilities.
aCNCNIUSTM.how_to_use: Aggregate aCNCNGWXOM and aCNCNIUSTM for the complete CKD 4WD ordinary hybrid SUV production picture. Monitoring the relative trend between these two lines reveals which specific JV brand is holding share better — if one line declines faster than the other, it signals brand-specific competitive differentiation in a segment facing broad pressure from Chinese PHEV SUVs. Combined monthly output below 10,000 units would signal serious Japanese hybrid SUV market-share erosion.

aCNCNBCHBM.description: Ordinary hybrid sport utility vehicle (SUV) production, CKD, two-wheel drive
aCNCNBCHBM.meaning: Monthly production of CKD-assembled, two-wheel-drive ordinary hybrid SUVs in China, published by CAAM. Two-wheel-drive HEV SUVs are the volume leaders in the CKD hybrid segment — most Japanese hybrid SUV buyers in China prefer 2WD (sufficient for urban use) and the lower cost vs. 4WD. This includes Toyota RAV4 Hybrid 2WD, Honda CR-V e:HEV 2WD, and similar.
aCNCNBCHBM.how_to_use: CKD 2WD HEV SUV production is the highest-volume series in the ordinary hybrid SUV family. Monthly volumes above 15,000 units indicate Toyota/Honda JV HEV SUVs are holding position in China's mid-SUV market; below 10,000 units signals accelerating share loss to Chinese PHEV equivalents. The critical competitive comparison: BYD Song Plus DM-i (PHEV, ~CNY 150,000, 1,200 km range) versus Toyota RAV4 Hybrid (HEV, ~CNY 200,000, ~700 km). The price-and-range advantage of PHEV is shifting the market decisively.

aCNCNABZXM.description: Ordinary hybrid sport utility vehicle (SUV) production, CKD, two-wheel drive
aCNCNABZXM.meaning: Second CAAM monthly series for CKD-assembled, two-wheel-drive ordinary hybrid SUV production, covering an additional JV OEM line. Published within standard 2-3 week post-month-end CAAM release window. The two CKD 2WD HEV SUV series (aCNCNBCHBM and this one) together capture the dominant JV HEV SUV CKD assembly in China.
aCNCNABZXM.how_to_use: Aggregate aCNCNBCHBM and aCNCNABZXM for the total CKD 2WD ordinary hybrid SUV picture. Combined monthly production in this pair exceeding 20,000 units indicates Japanese JV HEV SUVs are maintaining volume despite PHEV competition. Cross the combined CKD 2WD HEV SUV total against aCNSLNEVHP (NEV domestic sales) — the ratio of HEV SUV CKD production to total NEV sales is a useful measure of the conventional hybrid's residual relevance in China's electrification transition.

aCNCNEPGMM.description: Ordinary hybrid sport utility vehicle (SUV) production, domestic manufacturing, four wheel drive, Automobiles & Transport, Monthly, CAAM - China Association of Automobile Manufacturers
aCNCNEPGMM.meaning: Monthly production of domestically manufactured (non-CKD) four-wheel-drive ordinary hybrid SUVs, published by CAAM. Domestic HEV SUV production includes both JV models where hybrid systems have been fully localised (more common for Toyota) and Chinese domestic brand HEVs. Monthly volumes are typically lower than CKD equivalents, reflecting lower localisation of hybrid drivetrain technology.
aCNCNEPGMM.how_to_use: Domestic 4WD HEV SUV production growth (vs. CKD) indicates hybrid drivetrain localisation progress — a prerequisite for qualifying for domestic content incentives and eventually for the remaining hybrid vehicle tax benefits. Cross with Toyota's localisation announcements: Toyota has committed to localising THS components in China, which would shift production from CKD (aCNCNGWXOM) toward domestic (this series) over time. Rising domestic HEV production alongside falling CKD HEV production is a positive localisation signal, not a demand signal.

aCNCNIZYM.description: Ordinary hybrid sport utility vehicle (SUV) production, domestic manufacturing, four wheel drive, Volume, Automobiles & Transport, Monthly, CAAM - China Association of Automobile Manufacturers
aCNCNIZYM.meaning: Second CAAM monthly series for domestically manufactured four-wheel-drive ordinary hybrid SUV production. Published on standard CAAM 2-3 week post-month-end release schedule. Together with aCNCNEPGMM, this covers all domestic 4WD HEV SUV production in China across all OEM lines.
aCNCNIZYM.how_to_use: Aggregate aCNCNEPGMM and aCNCNIZYM for total domestic 4WD ordinary HEV SUV output. Compare with CKD 4WD equivalents (aCNCNGWXOM + aCNCNIUSTM) to compute the localisation ratio — target for most JV hybrid programmes is >70% domestic content by the end of the 14th Five-Year Plan (2025). A rising domestic/CKD ratio confirms hybrid localisation progress and has implications for foreign hybrid component suppliers (Denso, Aisin hybrid systems facing domestic competition).

aCNCNBLIGM.description: Ordinary hybrid sport utility vehicle (SUV) production, domestic manufacturing, two-wheel drive, Automobiles & Transport, Monthly, CAAM - China Association of Automobile Manufacturers
aCNCNBLIGM.meaning: Monthly production of domestically manufactured two-wheel-drive ordinary hybrid SUVs, published by CAAM. This is the domestic counterpart to aCNCNBCHBM (CKD 2WD HEV SUV). Domestic 2WD HEV SUVs represent the most commercially viable HEV SUV variant — combining domestic content (cost reduction) with the 2WD configuration preferred by most urban Chinese buyers.
aCNCNBLIGM.how_to_use: Domestic 2WD HEV SUV production is the indicator to watch for hybrid system localisation progress in China's most important HEV sub-segment. Rising production here alongside declining CKD 2WD HEV SUV output (aCNCNBCHBM) is a positive supply-chain localisation signal. Note that Chinese domestic brand HEVs (Great Wall Haval H6 HEV, SAIC Roewe HEV) are produced here too — this series is not exclusively JV-brand production.

aCNCNECUHM.description: Ordinary hybrid sport utility vehicle (SUV) production, domestic manufacturing, two-wheel drive, Automobiles & Transport, Monthly, CAAM - China Association of Automobile Manufacturers
aCNCNECUHM.meaning: Second CAAM monthly series for domestically manufactured two-wheel-drive ordinary hybrid SUV production, covering an additional OEM line. Published within the standard CAAM 2-3 week reporting window. Together with aCNCNBLIGM, these two series cover all domestic 2WD HEV SUV production in China.
aCNCNECUHM.how_to_use: Aggregate aCNCNBLIGM and aCNCNECUHM for the complete domestic 2WD ordinary hybrid SUV total. Compare the combined domestic 2WD HEV SUV total with the combined CKD 2WD equivalent (aCNCNBCHBM + aCNCNABZXM) — the domestic/CKD ratio for 2WD HEV SUVs is the most actionable localisation indicator given 2WD dominates the HEV SUV mix by volume. A domestic/CKD ratio above 1.0 marks localisation maturity in this sub-segment.

aCNCNDWQRM.description: Ordinary hybrid sport utility vehicle (SUV) production, domestic manufacturing, two-wheel drive, Volume, Automobiles & Transport, Monthly, CAAM - China Association of Automobile Manufacturers
aCNCNDWQRM.meaning: Third CAAM monthly series for domestically manufactured two-wheel-drive ordinary hybrid SUV production. The presence of three domestic 2WD HEV SUV RICs reflects multiple OEM production lines being tracked by CAAM — suggesting the domestic HEV SUV market has at least three significant production facilities. Published within 2-3 weeks of month-end.
aCNCNDWQRM.how_to_use: Add to aCNCNBLIGM and aCNCNECUHM for the full domestic 2WD HEV SUV count. With three lines tracked, this segment is more diversified than might be expected for a declining technology. The diversification likely reflects Chinese domestic brands (not just JV brands) that have developed independent HEV systems — Great Wall's DHT hybrid, BYD's older non-plug-in hybrid, and SAIC's BlueDrive system all produce in this category.

aCNCNDWUM.description: Ordinary hybrid sport utility vehicle (SUV) production, domestic manufacturing, two-wheel drive, Volume, Automobiles & Transport, Monthly, CAAM - China Association of Automobile Manufacturers
aCNCNDWUM.meaning: Fourth CAAM monthly series for domestically manufactured two-wheel-drive ordinary hybrid SUV production. The existence of four domestic 2WD HEV SUV RICs (aCNCNBLIGM, aCNCNECUHM, aCNCNDWQRM, and this one) underscores the breadth of HEV SUV manufacturing across multiple Chinese OEM lines — an indicator that ordinary hybrid technology achieved meaningful scale in China before being superseded by plug-in systems.
aCNCNDWUM.how_to_use: Aggregate all four domestic 2WD HEV SUV series. The combined monthly total in 2023 was likely in the range of 30,000-60,000 units — representing a multi-billion CNY annual revenue segment for HEV component suppliers. The decline trajectory of this aggregate is the key signal for NTN bearing, Aisin AT, and Denso component suppliers dependent on conventional hybrid volumes in China. A >25% YoY decline sustained for 3+ months signals accelerating HEV-to-PHEV substitution in the Chinese SUV market.

aCNCNPLFPM.meaning: Monthly production of ordinary hybrid trucks (non-plug-in HEV trucks) in China, published by CAAM. Hybrid trucks use regenerative braking and mild-hybrid start-stop systems to reduce fuel consumption — attractive for urban delivery trucks operating in stop-start conditions where regenerative braking yield is highest. Key producers include Dongfeng and FAW with their mild-hybrid van and medium-truck derivatives.
aCNCNPLFPM.how_to_use: Ordinary hybrid truck production is most relevant for the urban last-mile delivery segment. Monthly production above 3,000 units signals meaningful fleet adoption of hybrid trucks in China's logistics sector. Cross with BEV urban delivery truck/van production to assess the electrification pathway — as charging infrastructure improves in Chinese distribution centres, pure BEV trucks will outcompete HEV on total cost of ownership. The tipping point for urban freight is estimated at BEV cost parity around 2025-2026.

aCNCNCPSJM.meaning: Second CAAM monthly series for ordinary hybrid truck production, tracking a separate OEM line from aCNCNPLFPM. Published on standard 2-3 week post-month-end CAAM release schedule. Together, aCNCNPLFPM and aCNCNCPSJM cover the full range of ordinary hybrid truck production in China across major manufacturers.
aCNCNCPSJM.how_to_use: Aggregate aCNCNPLFPM and aCNCNCPSJM for total ordinary hybrid truck production. The combined monthly figure, cross-referenced against BEV light commercial vehicle production data, enables computation of the HEV share in China's electrified commercial vehicle output — this ratio is shifting rapidly toward BEV as range and cost barriers for electric vans are removed. Hybrid trucks face a more acute competitive pressure than hybrid buses because BEV vans (SAIC MAXUS, BYD ETM) can serve most urban routes on a single charge.

aCNCNBZZZM.description: Ordinary hybrid truck production, light weight
aCNCNBZZZM.meaning: Monthly production of light-weight ordinary hybrid trucks in China, published by CAAM. Light hybrid trucks (typically GVW below 3.5 tonnes) serve urban last-mile logistics, food delivery, and intra-city distribution. The hybrid technology in this class primarily targets fuel savings in dense urban stop-start operations. Chinese light commercial vehicle producers including Dongfeng Xiaokang, SAIC MAXUS, and JAC produce variants in this class.
aCNCNBZZZM.how_to_use: Light hybrid trucks are the most directly competitive segment with BEV light commercial vehicles. The BEV van/truck from SAIC MAXUS EV30 or BYD T3 offers near-equivalent utility to a light hybrid truck at lower running costs in urban settings. Monthly light HEV truck production above 5,000 units indicates fleet operators still see value in hybrid (primarily range flexibility and lower upfront cost vs. BEV). Below 2,000 units/month signals that BEV adoption in urban light logistics has progressed sufficiently to displace hybrid technology.

aCNCNPGIM.meaning: Monthly total passenger car sales in China (all types, all powertrains, all displacement classes), published by CAAM and CPCA (China Passenger Car Association), typically released within 10-14 days of month-end. This is one of the most closely watched monthly economic indicators in China, serving as a real-time proxy for consumer spending. China's passenger car sales totalled approximately 26 million units in 2024.
aCNCNPGIM.how_to_use: A monthly run-rate above 2.2 million passenger cars (annualised ~26M) is consistent with a healthy consumer demand environment; below 1.9 million signals cyclical weakness or seasonal trough. Decompose by powertrain: the rising NEV share (aCNSLNEVHP / aCNCNPGIM) is the critical structural metric — this ratio crossed 50% in late 2024 for the first time. Any month where passenger car total sales grow YoY more than 5% while gasoline-specific sales decline confirms that NEV volume growth is exceeding ICE volume loss, net-positive for total market.

aCNCNLQEMM.description: Passenger car sales, CKD, 3.0 liter < ≤4.0 liters
aCNCNLQEMM.meaning: Monthly sales of CKD-assembled passenger cars with 3.0–4.0 litre engine displacement, published by CAAM. CKD passenger cars in the 3.0–4.0L band are predominantly premium and luxury models assembled from imported kits — BMW 5-series, Audi A6L, Mercedes E-Class, and similar executive sedans. This segment commands high ASPs and is sensitive to luxury demand cycles and consumption tax policy.
aCNCNLQEMM.how_to_use: China's consumption tax on 3.0–4.0L vehicles is 25% (vs. 40% above 4.0L) — still a significant cost that limits volumes relative to the 2.0–2.5L band. Monthly sales in this band typically run 15,000-30,000 units in a healthy luxury market; below 12,000 signals either demand weakness or accelerating localisation (models moving from CKD to fully domestic JV assembly, migrating volumes out of this CKD series). Cross with German OEM China delivery data — BMW, Mercedes, Audi together dominate this displacement/CKD intersection.

aCNCNGEAYM.description: Passenger car sales, CKD, 3.0 liter < ≤4.0 liters
aCNCNGEAYM.meaning: Second CAAM monthly series for CKD passenger car sales in the 3.0–4.0 litre displacement range, tracking an additional OEM line. Published on standard 2-3 week post-month-end CAAM schedule. The existence of two RICs for this sub-segment indicates at least two significant JV OEM lines producing CKD-assembled luxury sedans in this displacement band.
aCNCNGEAYM.how_to_use: Aggregate aCNCNLQEMM and aCNCNGEAYM for the total CKD 3.0–4.0L passenger car sales. The combined monthly figure provides a cleaner luxury-sedan demand signal. Cross the combined CKD 3.0–4.0L sales against the fully imported luxury sedan data (aCNIMCARRP) to understand the import-vs.-domestic-assembly split in the premium sedan market — a ratio that has shifted significantly toward domestic CKD assembly over the past decade as German brands localised their flagship models in China.

aCNCNBBGWM.description: Passenger car sales, CKD, manual file
aCNCNBBGWM.meaning: Monthly sales of CKD-assembled passenger cars with manual transmission, published by CAAM. Manual transmission CKD passenger car sales are a declining niche — automatic transmission penetration in China's new car market exceeds 90%. Residual manual transmission CKD car sales serve enthusiast buyers (sporty models with manual options, e.g., certain BMW M-series, Honda Civic Type-R) and budget-segment CKD models where manual is still offered.
aCNCNBBGWM.how_to_use: Manual transmission CKD passenger car sales should be trending toward zero over time. Monthly volumes likely below 5,000 units nationally. A sudden spike may indicate a specific model launch (e.g., a Japanese sports car with manual-only option entering the market). More broadly, this series confirms the structural shift away from manual transmissions in China — analogous to similar series in other markets. Any sustained reading above 3,000 units implies a stronger enthusiast or budget-CKD manual market than expected.

aCNCNFAVJM.description: Passenger car sales, domestic manufacturing, > 4.0 liters
aCNCNFAVJM.meaning: Monthly sales of domestically manufactured passenger cars with engine displacement above 4.0 litres, published by CAAM. This is the extreme-upper end of the Chinese domestic passenger car market — a segment subject to the maximum 40% consumption tax that structurally limits volumes. Models include locally assembled BMW 7-series (4.4L V8 for Chinese market), Mercedes S-Class (when locally made), and some Audi A8L variants.
aCNCNFAVJM.how_to_use: Monthly domestic sales of 4.0L+ cars are typically below 2,000 units nationally due to the punitive consumption tax. Any reading above 3,000 units/month warrants investigation — it may indicate a model launch event or temporary tax relief. Cross with imported luxury car data: when both domestic and imported 4.0L+ sales rise together, it signals a luxury supercycle; when domestic rises while imports fall, it indicates specific model localisation. This segment is essentially irrelevant to NEV transition tracking but is a useful UHNW consumer sentiment barometer.

aCNCNGVROM.description: Plug-in hybrid bus production, light weight
aCNCNGVROM.subcategory: New Energy Vehicles — Plug-in Hybrid Buses
aCNCNGVROM.meaning: Monthly production of light-weight plug-in hybrid (PHEV) buses in China, published by CAAM. PHEV buses can operate in full-electric mode for city routes (typically 50-80 km EV range) and switch to hybrid for longer routes — making them popular for intercity and semi-urban transit where charging infrastructure is less dense than in major cities. Yutong, King Long, and BYD produce PHEV bus variants in the light-weight category.
aCNCNGVROM.how_to_use: PHEV bus production is a transitional technology between conventional hybrid and full BEV — it is most relevant where charging infrastructure is insufficient for full-BEV buses but operators want to reduce emissions. Monthly production above 1,000 units signals PHEV buses are genuinely competitive in the mid-market transit segment. Cross with full BEV bus data: as BEV bus range improves and charging infrastructure expands, PHEV buses face progressive obsolescence. PHEV bus production peaks and then declines as BEV buses achieve sufficient range are a common pattern in advanced transit markets.

aCNCNQRSQM.description: Plug-in hybrid sport utility vehicle (SUV) production, CKD, four-wheel drive
aCNCNQRSQM.subcategory: New Energy Vehicles — Plug-in Hybrid SUV (CKD, 4WD)
aCNCNQRSQM.meaning: Monthly production of CKD-assembled, four-wheel-drive plug-in hybrid SUVs in China, published by CAAM. PHEV SUVs assembled via CKD kits include high-profile JV models — BMW X5 PHEV (manufactured in Shenyang), Mercedes GLE PHEV, and Porsche Cayenne PHEV (CKD in certain configurations). This segment is growing as European luxury brands introduce PHEV variants to comply with China's dual-credit NEV policy.
aCNCNQRSQM.how_to_use: CKD PHEV SUV 4WD production tracks JV luxury brand NEV compliance strategy in China. Under China's dual-credit system, each PHEV SUV sold earns positive NEV credits, incentivising luxury OEMs to CKD-assemble PHEV variants locally. Monthly production above 3,000 units indicates JV PHEV SUV models are achieving meaningful sales volumes and contributing to dual-credit compliance. Cross with aCNCNMTZVM (a second PHEV SUV CKD 4WD line) and the NEV total (aCNSLNEVHP) to compute JV PHEV SUV's contribution to China's overall NEV mix.

aCNCNMTZVM.description: Plug-in hybrid sport utility vehicle (SUV) production, CKD, four-wheel drive
aCNCNMTZVM.subcategory: New Energy Vehicles — Plug-in Hybrid SUV (CKD, 4WD)
aCNCNMTZVM.meaning: Second CAAM monthly series for CKD-assembled four-wheel-drive plug-in hybrid SUV production, covering an additional JV OEM line from aCNCNQRSQM. Published within standard 2-3 week CAAM post-month-end release. Both CKD PHEV SUV 4WD series together capture the JV-dominated PHEV SUV production in China across all major European and Japanese brands offering CKD PHEV SUV variants.
aCNCNMTZVM.how_to_use: Aggregate aCNCNQRSQM and aCNCNMTZVM for total CKD 4WD PHEV SUV production. Compare the combined output against domestic Chinese brand PHEV SUV production (tracked in other CAAM series not in this batch) — the JV PHEV SUV share of total PHEV SUV market is declining as Chinese brands (BYD Tang DM, Li Auto L9, AITO M9) produce PHEV SUVs at significantly higher volume and lower cost. A JV CKD PHEV SUV share below 15% of total PHEV SUV production signals that JV brands have lost the PHEV SUV value proposition battle to Chinese OEMs.

aCNCNKBSBM.description: Plug-in hybrid sport utility vehicle (SUV) production, CKD, two-wheel drive
aCNCNKBSBM.meaning: China Motor Vehicles: Plug-in hybrid sport utility vehicle (SUV) production, CKD, two-wheel drive. Auto-industry statistic — China is the world's largest auto market (~30M units/year).
aCNCNKBSBM.how_to_use: China auto market: ICE sales declining, NEV (new energy vehicle, including BEV + PHEV + FCEV) penetration ~50% in 2024 — rapid EV transition. BYD, Tesla, Geely, Great Wall lead. Watch alongside ride-hailing / charging-infrastructure indicators.

aCNCNQIKWP.description: INTER-PROVC MID&L-T DIRECT ELECTRICITY TRADING- LIAONING(CMLV)
aCNCNQIKWP.meaning: Inter-provincial mid- and long-term direct electricity trading volume, Liaoning Province. Monthly series published by SEEC / NEA (National Energy Administration). Measures contracted electricity volumes traded directly between generators and large consumers across provincial boundaries.
aCNCNQIKWP.how_to_use: Direct electricity trading (DET) is China's market-based power sector reform mechanism, bypassing regulated utility pricing. Liaoning's inter-provincial DET volumes reflect Northeast China's surplus hydro and coal power exports to deficit regions. Rising volumes indicate progress in marketization and grid interconnection. Pair with thermal/hydro utilization hours (aCNAUHTHRA, aCNAUHHYDA) to assess supply-demand balance.

aCNCNNFEKP.description: INTER-PROVC MID&L-T DIRECT ELECTRICITY TRADING- NATIONWIDE(CMLV)
aCNCNNFEKP.meaning: Inter-provincial mid- and long-term direct electricity trading volume, nationwide total. Monthly series published by NEA / SEEC. Aggregates all DET volumes across all provincial grids.
aCNCNNFEKP.how_to_use: The national DET aggregate is a leading indicator of China's power market liberalization progress. The proportion of electricity sold via DET vs regulated utility tariffs measures how fast China is transitioning to market-based energy pricing. Rising DET share reduces cross-subsidy distortions and is a prerequisite for effective carbon pricing through the national ETS. Use with aCNCNXJAZR (DET ratio to consumption) and aCNCESTCUM (industrial electricity consumption).

aCNCNFUBZP.description: INTER-PROVC MID&L-T DIRECT ELECTRICITY TRADING- XINJIANG(CMLV)
aCNCNFUBZP.meaning: Inter-provincial mid- and long-term direct electricity trading volume, Xinjiang. Monthly series published by NEA. Tracks DET volumes for Xinjiang's grid — a major renewable energy surplus region.
aCNCNFUBZP.how_to_use: Xinjiang is China's largest renewable energy base (wind + solar), but its remote location creates severe curtailment problems. Inter-provincial DET from Xinjiang to eastern load centers (via ultra-high-voltage transmission lines) directly measures curtailment reduction. Rising Xinjiang DET exports are bullish for renewable capacity utilization and the net-zero-by-2060 pathway. Track alongside Xinjiang wind/solar output and UHV line utilization data.

aCNCNKZJPR.description: MID&L-T DIRECT ELECTRICITY TRADING RATIO TO CNSMPT- HENAN(CMLV)
aCNCNKZJPR.meaning: Mid- and long-term direct electricity trading as a ratio to total consumption, Henan Province. Monthly series published by NEA. Measures market liberalization depth in Henan's power sector.
aCNCNKZJPR.how_to_use: Henan is a large industrial province and power consumer. The DET ratio shows what share of Henan's electricity is priced through market mechanisms. A rising ratio means more industrial consumers face market electricity prices — improving efficiency signals but also exposing them to price volatility. Critical context for China's carbon neutrality push: market prices that reflect carbon costs drive energy efficiency investment.

aCNCNKZFLR.description: MID&L-T DIRECT ELECTRICITY TRADING RATIO TO CNSMPT- WEST INNER MONGOLIA GRID(CMLV)
aCNCNKZFLR.meaning: Mid- and long-term direct electricity trading ratio to consumption, West Inner Mongolia Grid. Monthly series published by NEA. Tracks market depth in Inner Mongolia's western grid — a major coal and wind power hub.
aCNCNKZFLR.how_to_use: Inner Mongolia (West Grid) is China's largest coal-power and wind-power province. The DET ratio here determines whether wind curtailment is being addressed through market mechanisms or administrative command. High DET ratios + rising wind utilization hours indicate effective market-based dispatch. Relevant for assessing China's wind industry economics and carbon emission trajectory.

aCNCNEVNUP.meaning: Mid- and long-term direct electricity trading volume, nationwide total (CMLV basis). Monthly series from NEA. Similar to aCNCNNFEKP but may use a different accounting basis (cumulative volume less variation).
aCNCNEVNUP.how_to_use: Use alongside aCNCNNFEKP to cross-check national DET volumes and identify measurement methodology differences. DET volume growth is a key reform KPI — the government targets full market pricing by 2025-2030. Rising volumes signal reform progress and reduce the need for costly government price subsidies. Essential for assessing whether China's power sector is ready for a robust carbon market.

aCNCNXJAZR.description: MID&L-T DIRECT ELECY TRADING RATIO TO CNSMPT- NATIONWIDE(CMLV)
aCNCNXJAZR.meaning: Mid- and long-term direct electricity trading as a ratio to total consumption, nationwide. Monthly series published by NEA. The headline power market liberalization depth indicator.
aCNCNXJAZR.how_to_use: The national DET/consumption ratio is the primary measure of China's electricity market reform progress. By 2023, this ratio exceeded 60% nationally — a major milestone. Full marketization is a precondition for effective carbon pricing (national ETS). A rising ratio also signals more accurate price signals for investment in renewables vs coal. Cross-reference with carbon credit prices (national ETS) and coal power generation margins.

aCNCNCNQOR.description: MID&L-T DIRECT ELECY TRADING RATIO TO CNSMPT- STATE GRID(CMLV)
aCNCNCNQOR.meaning: Mid- and long-term direct electricity trading ratio to consumption, State Grid Corporation area. Monthly series published by NEA. Covers the State Grid's service territory (most of China excluding Southern Grid provinces).
aCNCNCNQOR.how_to_use: State Grid controls ~75% of China's grid. The DET ratio within State Grid territory is the dominant driver of the national ratio. State Grid's progress in power market reform directly determines the pace of electricity price liberalization and ultimately carbon neutrality. Use to separate State Grid vs Southern Grid reform speeds and identify jurisdictional heterogeneity.

aCNCNHMZJP.description: PROVC MID&L-T DIRECT ELECTRICITY TRADING- GUANGXI(CMLV)
aCNCNHMZJP.meaning: Provincial mid- and long-term direct electricity trading volume, Guangxi. Monthly series published by NEA. Tracks DET within Guangxi's provincial grid — a hydro-rich Southern Grid province.
aCNCNHMZJP.how_to_use: Guangxi has significant hydropower capacity (Hongshui River cascade). DET volumes here reflect intra-provincial market trading between hydro generators and industrial consumers (aluminium smelters are major Guangxi power consumers). Strong hydro years flood the market with cheap electricity, boosting DET volumes and benefiting energy-intensive industry. Pair with Yunnan/Guangxi hydro output and aluminium production data.

aCNCNYXGMP.description: PROVC MID&L-T DIRECT ELECTRICITY TRADING- NATIONWIDE(CMLV)
aCNCNYXGMP.meaning: Provincial mid- and long-term direct electricity trading volume, nationwide (provincial-level aggregate). Monthly series published by NEA. Sums all intra- provincial DET volumes across China.
aCNCNYXGMP.how_to_use: The provincial DET aggregate complements inter-provincial DET (aCNCNNFEKP) to give a full picture of China's direct electricity trading market. Intra-provincial trading liberalization often precedes inter-provincial. High provincial DET volumes indicate that local generators and consumers are successfully contracting directly — reducing utility middlemen and improving efficiency.

aCNCNSUZHP.description: PROVC MID&L-T DIRECT ELECY TRADING- WEST INNER MONGOLIA(CMLV)
aCNCNSUZHP.meaning: Provincial mid- and long-term direct electricity trading volume, West Inner Mongolia. Monthly series published by NEA. Measures intra-provincial DET in the resource-rich western Inner Mongolia grid zone.
aCNCNSUZHP.how_to_use: West Inner Mongolia has extraordinary wind and solar resources. Provincial DET here is the mechanism through which renewable generators sell power directly to industrial users (data centers, green hydrogen producers, mining operations). Rising volumes signal progress in integrating variable renewable energy into the industrial supply chain — a key enabler of China's green hydrogen strategy.

aCNCNKIMF.description: Power generation capacity, hydropower, Yunnan Province
aCNCNKIMF.meaning: Power generation capacity, hydropower, Yunnan Province. Annual series from NEA / NBS. Measures installed hydropower capacity (GW) in Yunnan.
aCNCNKIMF.how_to_use: Yunnan is China's largest hydropower province (Jinsha, Lancang, Nu River cascades). Installed capacity expansion tracks the pace of China's renewable build-out — hydro remains the backbone of clean power alongside wind and solar. However, Yunnan hydro is subject to drought risk: the 2021-22 drought caused severe power shortages. Pair with precipitation data, reservoir levels, and aCNAUHHYDA (hydro utilization hours) to assess generation reliability.

aCNCNMGVP.description: City public steam (electric) car standard operation
aCNCNMGVP.meaning: City public steam (electric) car standard operation volume. Annual NBS urban transport statistic measuring the scale of city bus and tram operations (vehicle-km or equivalent standard operation units).
aCNCNMGVP.how_to_use: Public transit ridership and capacity are urban mobility indicators tied to urbanization quality. China has the world's largest urban bus fleet; rapid electrification (NEV buses) is underway. Rising operation volumes reflect expanding urban populations and transport infrastructure. Declining volumes may signal private car competition or post-COVID modal shift. Use with aCNCNQQBR (rural car ownership) to gauge urban vs rural mobility dynamics.
