aCNCNNGGM1.description: Generator set (power generation equipment) output, Tianjin Municipality
aCNCNNGGM1.meaning: Monthly output of generator sets (power generation equipment) by industrial enterprises above designated size in Tianjin Municipality. Published by NBS Tianjin Bureau as part of the regional industrial production statistics, typically released in the second or third week of the following month. Tianjin hosts several medium-sized generator set manufacturers supplying both domestic and export markets, including standby diesel generators.
aCNCNNGGM1.how_to_use: Tianjin generator output is a proxy for backup power equipment demand — peaks typically coincide with rural electrification drives, infrastructure projects, and export surges to Southeast Asia and Africa. Compare with the national generator output series to assess Tianjin's market share. A Tianjin output surge of 20%+ YoY often reflects BRI project equipment procurement cycles. Cross-reference with Xinjiang output (aCNCNTLIOM) for geographic demand pattern contrast.

aCNCNTLIOM.description: Generator set (power generation equipment) output, Xinjiang Uyghur Autonomous Region, Current Period, Year on Year Growth
aCNCNTLIOM.subcategory: Generator Set Output — Xinjiang, YoY Growth (Current Period)
aCNCNTLIOM.meaning: Year-on-year growth rate of generator set output in the current period for industrial enterprises above designated size in Xinjiang Uyghur Autonomous Region. Published by NBS Xinjiang Bureau monthly, typically in the second or third week of the following month. Xinjiang has become a significant industrial hub with coal-based power generation infrastructure and equipment manufacturing capacity expansion driven by westward development policies.
aCNCNTLIOM.how_to_use: Xinjiang generator output growth above 15% YoY signals accelerating industrial build-out in China's western energy base — the region is critical for coal-fired power and increasingly wind/solar hybrid systems. Sharp growth spikes may reflect policy-driven energy security investments post-2021 power crisis. Compare with Tianjin (aCNCNNGGM1) to isolate regional policy vs. market-driven demand effects. Large divergences between Xinjiang and coastal regions highlight east-west industrial policy asymmetry.

aCNCNPCIHM.meaning: Monthly production of harvesting machinery (combine harvesters, grain threshers, rice harvesters) in China, published by the NBS. China is the world's largest agricultural machinery producer; major producers include XCMG, CNHTC, Zoomlion, and Weichai Power. Harvesting machinery is steel and cast iron-intensive, consuming structural steel, castings, and precision forgings.
aCNCNPCIHM.how_to_use: Use as an indirect metals demand indicator for the agricultural machinery sector — rising harvesting machinery output implies higher consumption of special steels, castings (aCNCNHAFYM), and precision gears. Cross with aCNCNPGIUM (cast steel) and aCNCNCNPCIHM: a concurrent rise in both harvesting machinery and cast steel production points to broad agricultural equipment cycle expansion, which historically peaks in Q1-Q2 ahead of summer grain harvest seasons.

aCNCNEIAHM.meaning: China industrial output: Household refrigerator production, Hunan Province. Industrial-sector production data for specific products or sub-sectors.
aCNCNEIAHM.how_to_use: Track for sector-cycle dynamics. China is the world's largest producer of steel, cement, copper, aluminum, and many other industrial commodities. Sustained production declines signal industrial-sector deceleration; sustained increases reflect capacity expansion or commodity-cycle peaks.

aCNCNEEEWM.description: Household washing machine output, Henan Province
aCNCNEEEWM.subcategory: Household Washing Machine Output — Henan Province
aCNCNEEEWM.meaning: Monthly output of household washing machines by industrial enterprises above designated size in Henan Province. Published by NBS Henan Bureau, typically released in the second or third week of the following month. Henan has emerged as a significant white goods manufacturing hub, with Haier, Midea, and local producers operating facilities there, benefiting from lower land/labor costs versus coastal provinces.
aCNCNEEEWM.how_to_use: Henan washing machine output is a useful indicator of inland consumer electronics manufacturing momentum — strong readings (10%+ YoY growth) reflect both domestic demand recovery and import substitution success. Cross-reference with national household appliance retail sales (NBS retail data) to distinguish production-for-inventory from production-for-sale. Correlates with rural consumer credit expansion under China's 'sinking market' (下沉市场) consumption policy.

aCNCNGXRZM.subcategory: Industrial Boiler Production — Anhui Province (Series A)
aCNCNGXRZM.units: tonnes of steam per hour (t/h) capacity or units (monthly)
aCNCNGXRZM.meaning: Monthly production of industrial boilers by enterprises above designated size in Anhui Province, representing one of two Anhui boiler series in this dataset (see aCNCNEFYM for the paired series, likely current-period vs. cumulative distinction). Published by NBS Anhui Bureau, typically released in the second or third week of the following month. Anhui is a mid-tier industrial province with boiler manufacturing concentrated around Hefei and Wuhu.
aCNCNGXRZM.how_to_use: Industrial boiler output in Anhui correlates with provincial heavy industry activity — cement, chemicals, and textile sectors are the primary end-users. A production decline of 10%+ YoY often reflects environmental compliance-driven boiler replacement campaigns (coal-to-gas switching under Blue Sky Action) rather than demand weakness per se. Compare Anhui output against Hebei (aCNCNJWECM/aCNCNLTYHM) to gauge regional environmental compliance timing differences.

aCNCNEFYM.subcategory: Industrial Boiler Production — Anhui Province (Series B)
aCNCNEFYM.units: tonnes of steam per hour (t/h) capacity or units (monthly)
aCNCNEFYM.meaning: Monthly production of industrial boilers by enterprises above designated size in Anhui Province — this is the second of two Anhui boiler series, likely distinguished from aCNCNGXRZM by measurement variant (e.g., current period vs. cumulative, or units vs. capacity tonnes). Published by NBS Anhui Bureau, typically released in the second or third week of the following month.
aCNCNEFYM.how_to_use: Use in conjunction with aCNCNGXRZM to form a complete picture of Anhui's boiler manufacturing sector. When both series diverge significantly, check whether one tracks cumulative YTD output versus current-period monthly. Boiler production peaks typically occur in Q3-Q4 ahead of winter heating season procurement. Watch for policy-driven demand surges tied to coal-to-biomass boiler conversions under rural heating restructuring (农村煤改气/煤改电).

aCNCNAMGMM.subcategory: Industrial Boiler Production — Beijing Municipality (Series A)
aCNCNAMGMM.units: tonnes of steam per hour (t/h) capacity or units (monthly)
aCNCNAMGMM.meaning: Monthly production of industrial boilers by enterprises above designated size in Beijing Municipality, the first of two Beijing boiler series. Published by NBS Beijing Bureau, typically released in the second or third week of the following month. Beijing's industrial boiler market is shaped by stringent environmental restrictions — the city has aggressively phased out coal-fired industrial boilers under successive clean-air action plans since 2013.
aCNCNAMGMM.how_to_use: Beijing boiler output is a policy-sensitive indicator. A sharp production decline signals successful coal boiler retirement and clean-energy substitution — not economic weakness. By contrast, elevated output of natural gas or biomass boilers suggests active replacement cycle demand. Useful for gauging the pace of de-coaling in China's most-watched air quality region; compare with Hebei (aCNCNJWECM) where coal boiler phase-out started later.

aCNCNTOMXM.subcategory: Industrial Boiler Production — Beijing Municipality (Series B)
aCNCNTOMXM.units: tonnes of steam per hour (t/h) capacity or units (monthly)
aCNCNTOMXM.meaning: Monthly production of industrial boilers by enterprises above designated size in Beijing Municipality — the second of two Beijing boiler series, likely differentiated from aCNCNAMGMM by measurement variant (current period vs. cumulative, or different product sub-category). Published by NBS Beijing Bureau monthly.
aCNCNTOMXM.how_to_use: Pair with aCNCNAMGMM to capture the full Beijing boiler production profile. Given Beijing's near-complete phase-out of coal industrial boilers by 2020, persistent production here likely reflects gas-fired and electric boilers for district heating and industrial steam applications. Any rebound in boiler output in Beijing likely reflects replacement demand tied to aged district heating infrastructure upgrades, not new capacity addition.

aCNCNZMIWM.subcategory: Industrial Boiler Production — Chongqing Municipality (Series A)
aCNCNZMIWM.units: tonnes of steam per hour (t/h) capacity or units (monthly)
aCNCNZMIWM.meaning: Monthly production of industrial boilers by enterprises above designated size in Chongqing Municipality, the first of two Chongqing boiler series. Published by NBS Chongqing Bureau monthly, typically released in the second or third week of the following month. Chongqing is a major industrial municipality with significant chemical, automotive, and steel industries that are heavy boiler consumers.
aCNCNZMIWM.how_to_use: Chongqing boiler output reflects the industrial metabolism of southwest China's largest manufacturing hub. Strong production here correlates with activity at CQRC (Chongqing's chemical complex), Ford/Changan automotive lines, and local steel mills. Compare with the Hubei series (aCNCNHUTGM/aCNCNWZKIM) to assess broader Yangtze River belt industrial momentum. Seasonal peaks typically appear in Q2-Q3 before winter procurement cutoffs.

aCNCNRMTTM.subcategory: Industrial Boiler Production — Chongqing Municipality (Series B)
aCNCNRMTTM.units: tonnes of steam per hour (t/h) capacity or units (monthly)
aCNCNRMTTM.meaning: Monthly production of industrial boilers by enterprises above designated size in Chongqing Municipality — the second of two Chongqing series, likely differentiated by measurement period (current-period vs. cumulative) or product sub-category. Published by NBS Chongqing Bureau monthly.
aCNCNRMTTM.how_to_use: Use alongside aCNCNZMIWM to build a complete picture of Chongqing's boiler manufacturing capacity and demand signals. When comparing both series, check if one represents YTD cumulative tonnage and the other monthly units — a common NBS data architecture pattern. Chongqing boiler production diverging significantly from the national trend may reflect local environmental enforcement cycles or major infrastructure project procurement.

aCNCNXTXWM.subcategory: Industrial Boiler Production — Fujian Province (Series A)
aCNCNXTXWM.units: tonnes of steam per hour (t/h) capacity or units (monthly)
aCNCNXTXWM.meaning: Monthly production of industrial boilers by enterprises above designated size in Fujian Province (estimated/preliminary data, indicated by [e] in the source). Published by NBS Fujian Bureau monthly, typically released in the second or third week of the following month. Fujian is a coastal industrial province with significant textile, petrochemical (Fujian Refining and Ethylene), and paper industries driving boiler demand.
aCNCNXTXWM.how_to_use: The [e] flag indicates preliminary or estimated data — treat with wider confidence bands than finalized provincial series. Fujian's boiler output is closely tied to its petrochemical corridor (Quanzhou, Zhangzhou) and Taiwan-funded electronics and machinery manufacturers. Production above 15% YoY growth often coincides with major new petrochemical or paper mill commissioning. Cross-reference with Guangdong (aCNCNZICSM) for coastal industrial belt boiler demand comparison.

aCNCNACRJM.subcategory: Industrial Boiler Production — Fujian Province (Series B)
aCNCNACRJM.units: tonnes of steam per hour (t/h) capacity or units (monthly)
aCNCNACRJM.meaning: Monthly production of industrial boilers by enterprises above designated size in Fujian Province — the second of two Fujian boiler series (estimated/preliminary data). Published by NBS Fujian Bureau monthly. As with aCNCNXTXWM, the [e] flag indicates preliminary estimates subject to revision.
aCNCNACRJM.how_to_use: Pair with aCNCNXTXWM to build a complete view of Fujian boiler manufacturing. The two series may differ in measurement units (capacity tonnes vs. unit count) or aggregation period. Given Fujian's role as a cross-strait trade hub, boiler production here can reflect Taiwanese-invested factory expansions — a Taiwan manufacturing capex indicator in China. Monitor alongside cross-strait trade data for context.

aCNCNZICSM.subcategory: Industrial Boiler Production — Guangdong Province (Series A)
aCNCNZICSM.units: tonnes of steam per hour (t/h) capacity or units (monthly)
aCNCNZICSM.meaning: Monthly production of industrial boilers by enterprises above designated size in Guangdong Province, the first of two Guangdong boiler series. Published by NBS Guangdong Bureau monthly, typically released in the second or third week of the following month. Guangdong's boiler market is driven by the Pearl River Delta manufacturing complex — textiles, food processing, chemical, and electronics factories — one of the world's densest industrial clusters.
aCNCNZICSM.how_to_use: Guangdong boiler production is a high-frequency indicator of Pearl River Delta factory activity. The province's strict emission standards (Guangdong has led China in industrial boiler NOx controls) mean production increasingly reflects high-efficiency and low-emission equipment. YoY growth above 10% typically coincides with factory capacity expansion cycles driven by export orders. Compare with Zhejiang (aCNCNYXDIM/aCNCNSQZPM) for coastal manufacturing belt trends.

aCNCNYEGYM.subcategory: Industrial Boiler Production — Guangdong Province (Series B)
aCNCNYEGYM.units: tonnes of steam per hour (t/h) capacity or units (monthly)
aCNCNYEGYM.meaning: Monthly production of industrial boilers by enterprises above designated size in Guangdong Province — the second of two Guangdong boiler series, likely differentiated by measurement variant (current-period vs. cumulative, or units vs. capacity). Published by NBS Guangdong Bureau monthly.
aCNCNYEGYM.how_to_use: Use in conjunction with aCNCNZICSM to assess the full scope of Guangdong's boiler sector. Guangdong's transition away from coal-fired industrial boilers has been among the fastest in China — the province has targeted complete coal boiler phase-out in key cities by 2025. Therefore, divergence between the two series (if one tracks total output and the other tracks specific fuel-type boilers) reveals the structural energy transition underway in China's largest manufacturing province.

aCNCNJWECM.description: Industrial boiler production, Hebei ProvinceYear on Year Growth, Cumulative
aCNCNJWECM.subcategory: Industrial Boiler Production — Hebei Province, YoY Growth Cumulative
aCNCNJWECM.meaning: Cumulative year-on-year growth rate of industrial boiler production by enterprises above designated size in Hebei Province. Published by NBS Hebei Bureau monthly, typically released in the second or third week of the following month. Hebei surrounds Beijing and is China's most-watched province for industrial emission compliance — it hosts major steel, cement, and coal industries that are the primary boiler end-users.
aCNCNJWECM.how_to_use: Hebei boiler production is among the most policy-sensitive in China. Cumulative growth turning sharply negative (e.g., -20% to -40%) during major environmental enforcement campaigns (2017 '散乱污' crackdown, 2021 winter emission controls) confirms compliance-driven demand destruction. A rebound in cumulative growth after enforcement cycles signals replacement-demand for cleaner equipment. Critical context for anticipating Chinese steel and cement sector cost structures.

aCNCNLTYHM.description: Industrial boiler production, Hebei ProvinceYear on Year Growth, Current Period
aCNCNLTYHM.subcategory: Industrial Boiler Production — Hebei Province, YoY Growth Current Period
aCNCNLTYHM.meaning: Current-period (monthly) year-on-year growth rate of industrial boiler production by enterprises above designated size in Hebei Province. Published by NBS Hebei Bureau monthly. Unlike aCNCNJWECM (cumulative), this series captures month-by-month production momentum changes without smoothing from the YTD accumulation effect.
aCNCNLTYHM.how_to_use: The current-period YoY series is more volatile but faster-reacting than the cumulative series — swings of ±30% month-on-month YoY are common around Chinese New Year or major enforcement policy announcements. Use this for early-cycle detection: three consecutive months of recovering growth after negative prints often mark the turn in Hebei industrial activity. Pair with Tangshan steel mill utilization data for cross-sector validation.

aCNCNZKQGM.subcategory: Industrial Boiler Production — Heilongjiang Province (Series A)
aCNCNZKQGM.units: tonnes of steam per hour (t/h) capacity or units (monthly)
aCNCNZKQGM.meaning: Monthly production of industrial boilers by enterprises above designated size in Heilongjiang Province, the first of two Heilongjiang series. Published by NBS Heilongjiang Bureau monthly, typically in the second or third week of the following month. Heilongjiang is a northeastern rust-belt province with significant coal mining, petrochemical (Daqing oilfield), and grain-processing industries — all major boiler consumers for process heat and power.
aCNCNZKQGM.how_to_use: Heilongjiang boiler output is a northeast China industrial health indicator. The province's heavy dependence on district heating (극-cold winters, average January -20°C) means boiler production has a pronounced seasonal pattern with Q2-Q3 manufacturing peaks. Structural decline in coal mine operations and petrochemical output in Daqing (declining oilfield) exerts multi-year downward pressure — production running 10-20% below 2015 levels is the new baseline. Compare with Jilin and Liaoning for Northeast rust-belt industrial complex trends.

aCNCNJZRWM.subcategory: Industrial Boiler Production — Heilongjiang Province (Series B)
aCNCNJZRWM.units: tonnes of steam per hour (t/h) capacity or units (monthly)
aCNCNJZRWM.meaning: Monthly production of industrial boilers by enterprises above designated size in Heilongjiang Province — the second of two Heilongjiang boiler series, likely differentiated by measurement variant (current period vs. cumulative) or product sub-category. Published by NBS Heilongjiang Bureau monthly.
aCNCNJZRWM.how_to_use: Pair with aCNCNZKQGM for a complete picture of Heilongjiang's boiler manufacturing. Given the province's fiscal stress and SOE restructuring pressures, boiler manufacturers here often face tighter credit conditions than coastal peers — financial costs series (aCNCNQXHN) provide context. Any sustained recovery in Heilongjiang boiler output (two or more quarters of positive YoY) would signal genuine northeast industrial revitalization, a key policy goal under China's '振兴东北' strategy.

aCNCNPKOXM.subcategory: Industrial Boiler Production — Henan Province (Series A)
aCNCNPKOXM.units: tonnes of steam per hour (t/h) capacity or units (monthly)
aCNCNPKOXM.meaning: Monthly production of industrial boilers by enterprises above designated size in Henan Province, the first of two Henan boiler series. Published by NBS Henan Bureau monthly, typically in the second or third week of the following month. Henan is China's most populous province and a major industrial hub with significant food processing, aluminum smelting (Zhongyuan Aluminum), and coal chemical industries — all large boiler consumers.
aCNCNPKOXM.how_to_use: Henan boiler output correlates with provincial FAI in heavy industry — the province hosts some of China's largest aluminum smelters (energy-intensive, requiring massive steam generation). Boiler production YoY growth of 8%+ in Henan often signals fresh aluminum or chemical plant commissioning. Track alongside Henan's electricity consumption and industrial value-added for consistency checks. Environmental compliance crackdowns around Zhengzhou (PM2.5 controls) can create sharp production swings.

aCNCNEQZSM.subcategory: Industrial Boiler Production — Henan Province (Series B)
aCNCNEQZSM.units: tonnes of steam per hour (t/h) capacity or units (monthly)
aCNCNEQZSM.meaning: Monthly production of industrial boilers by enterprises above designated size in Henan Province — the second of two Henan series, likely differentiated by measurement period (current period vs. cumulative) or unit basis. Published by NBS Henan Bureau monthly.
aCNCNEQZSM.how_to_use: Pair with aCNCNPKOXM to construct a complete monthly Henan boiler production profile. Henan has been a priority province for coal boiler replacement under national air quality improvement programs — the province aims to replace over 1 million small coal boilers. This replacement cycle creates replacement demand rather than incremental demand, meaning positive output growth in a declining-coal-share environment reflects the ongoing equipment upgrade wave rather than new industrial capacity.

aCNCNHUTGM.subcategory: Industrial Boiler Production — Hubei Province (Series A)
aCNCNHUTGM.units: tonnes of steam per hour (t/h) capacity or units (monthly)
aCNCNHUTGM.meaning: Monthly production of industrial boilers by enterprises above designated size in Hubei Province, the first of two Hubei series. Published by NBS Hubei Bureau monthly, typically in the second or third week of the following month. Hubei (Wuhan) is a critical industrial province with automotive (Dongfeng Motor's base), steel (Wuhan Iron and Steel), and chemical industries — all significant boiler end-users.
aCNCNHUTGM.how_to_use: Hubei boiler production is closely linked to Wuhan's automotive and steel complex activity. The COVID-19 lockdown (January-April 2020) caused one of the most dramatic production collapses in this series — useful as a stress-test benchmark. Normal conditions: YoY growth of 5-10% tracks reasonably with provincial industrial value-added. Track alongside Dongfeng Motor production announcements and WISCO utilization rates for sector-specific context.

aCNCNWZKIM.subcategory: Industrial Boiler Production — Hubei Province (Series B)
aCNCNWZKIM.units: tonnes of steam per hour (t/h) capacity or units (monthly)
aCNCNWZKIM.meaning: Monthly production of industrial boilers by enterprises above designated size in Hubei Province — the second of two Hubei series. Published by NBS Hubei Bureau monthly. The pair (aCNCNHUTGM + aCNCNWZKIM) likely captures distinct measurement dimensions (current period vs. cumulative, or coal-fired vs. clean-fuel boilers) of the same provincial sector.
aCNCNWZKIM.how_to_use: Use in conjunction with aCNCNHUTGM to identify whether Hubei's boiler production momentum is broad-based or concentrated in specific product types. Given Hubei's position as a Yangtze River Economic Belt anchor province, boiler production trends here feed through to regional logistics and petrochemical infrastructure investment cycles. Monitor for post-flood (Hubei is prone to summer flooding) reconstruction demand spikes that can temporarily boost boiler orders.

aCNCNQUJVM.subcategory: Industrial Boiler Production — Hunan Province (Series A)
aCNCNQUJVM.units: tonnes of steam per hour (t/h) capacity or units (monthly)
aCNCNQUJVM.meaning: Monthly production of industrial boilers by enterprises above designated size in Hunan Province, the first of two Hunan series. Published by NBS Hunan Bureau monthly, typically in the second or third week of the following month. Hunan is an industrially diversified province with significant non-ferrous metals (Zhuzhou, Xiangtan), construction machinery (Sany, Zoomlion HQ in Changsha), and chemical industries requiring boiler equipment.
aCNCNQUJVM.how_to_use: Hunan boiler output correlates particularly well with the construction machinery upcycle — Sany and Zoomlion factories consume large quantities of industrial steam. A YoY growth acceleration above 12% in Hunan boiler production often leads excavator production starts by 1-2 months. Also sensitive to non-ferrous metals smelting activity (lead, zinc, copper in Zhuzhou), where process steam demand is material. Pair with Hunan electrical equipment output (aCNCNWGBGM) for a broader provincial industrial read.

aCNCNDSSM.subcategory: Industrial Boiler Production — Hunan Province (Series B)
aCNCNDSSM.units: tonnes of steam per hour (t/h) capacity or units (monthly)
aCNCNDSSM.meaning: Monthly production of industrial boilers by enterprises above designated size in Hunan Province — the second of two Hunan series. Published by NBS Hunan Bureau monthly. Likely captures a different measurement variant (current period vs. cumulative, or specific boiler sub-type) from aCNCNQUJVM.
aCNCNDSSM.how_to_use: Pair with aCNCNQUJVM for complete Hunan boiler production analysis. Hunan's environmental enforcement has been stricter in Changsha and Zhuzhou since 2017 (the province began aggressive NOx reduction campaigns), which structurally shifts boiler production toward gas-fired and biomass boilers. A bifurcation in the two Hunan series — one rising while the other falls — may indicate this fuel-type compositional shift within the province.

aCNCNPINCM.subcategory: Industrial Boiler Production — Jiangxi Province (Series A)
aCNCNPINCM.units: tonnes of steam per hour (t/h) capacity or units (monthly)
aCNCNPINCM.meaning: Monthly production of industrial boilers by enterprises above designated size in Jiangxi Province, the first of two Jiangxi series. Published by NBS Jiangxi Bureau monthly, typically in the second or third week of the following month. Jiangxi is a mid-sized industrial province with copper smelting (Jiangxi Copper, China's largest copper producer), ceramics, and new energy battery materials industries that drive boiler demand.
aCNCNPINCM.how_to_use: Jiangxi boiler output is a proxy for copper and rare earth processing activity — Jiangxi Copper's smelter complex is one of the world's largest and requires significant process steam. YoY growth above 10% in Jiangxi boilers often correlates with copper cathode production expansions. With Jiangxi's emergence as a lithium battery materials hub (NMC precursors), watch for new demand from battery chemical plants — a structural growth driver for specialized high-pressure boilers.

aCNCNEKAPM.subcategory: Industrial Boiler Production — Jiangxi Province (Series B)
aCNCNEKAPM.units: tonnes of steam per hour (t/h) capacity or units (monthly)
aCNCNEKAPM.meaning: Monthly production of industrial boilers by enterprises above designated size in Jiangxi Province — the second of two Jiangxi series. Published by NBS Jiangxi Bureau monthly. Paired with aCNCNPINCM to provide complementary measurement dimensions of Jiangxi's boiler manufacturing sector.
aCNCNEKAPM.how_to_use: Combine with aCNCNPINCM for a complete Jiangxi boiler view. Jiangxi's industrial policy emphasizes the 'four new economies' (new materials, new energy, new display, new medicine) — the boiler series here may capture increasing demand from lithium hydroxide processing plants, EV battery material precursor production, and emerging semiconductor chemical supply chains. Divergence between the two series signals structural mix shifts in boiler end-use.

aCNCNLQDPM.subcategory: Industrial Boiler Production — Liaoning Province (Series A)
aCNCNLQDPM.units: tonnes of steam per hour (t/h) capacity or units (monthly)
aCNCNLQDPM.meaning: Monthly production of industrial boilers by enterprises above designated size in Liaoning Province, the first of two Liaoning series. Published by NBS Liaoning Bureau monthly, typically in the second or third week of the following month. Liaoning (Shenyang, Dalian, Anshan) is the heart of China's northeast industrial base with major steel (Anshan Iron and Steel), petrochemical (PetroChina's Fushun, Dalian refineries), and heavy machinery industries.
aCNCNLQDPM.how_to_use: Liaoning boiler production is a bellwether for northeast China's long-standing industrial revitalization challenge. The province's steel sector (Anshan Steel, Benxi Steel) is the primary boiler demand driver — blast furnace and rolling mill operations require extensive steam generation. Persistent YoY declines (the structural norm since 2014) reflect secular overcapacity and SOE restructuring, not cyclical weakness. Any sustained recovery (+10% for 3+ consecutive months) would be significant policy news.

aCNCNOUM.subcategory: Industrial Boiler Production — Liaoning Province (Series B)
aCNCNOUM.units: tonnes of steam per hour (t/h) capacity or units (monthly)
aCNCNOUM.meaning: Monthly production of industrial boilers by enterprises above designated size in Liaoning Province — the second of two Liaoning series. Published by NBS Liaoning Bureau monthly. The pair (aCNCNLQDPM + aCNCNOUM) provides complementary measurement perspectives on Liaoning's boiler manufacturing sector.
aCNCNOUM.how_to_use: Use alongside aCNCNLQDPM to cross-check Liaoning boiler production trends. Dalian's chemical and shipbuilding complex (Dalian Shipbuilding Industry) drives separate boiler demand versus Shenyang and Anshan's heavy industry. If the two series diverge significantly, it may signal compositional shifts between coastal (Dalian) and inland (Shenyang-Anshan) industrial activity within the province — an important distinction given their different policy sensitivities.

aCNCNDDSGM.subcategory: Industrial Boiler Production — Shaanxi Province (Series A)
aCNCNDDSGM.units: tonnes of steam per hour (t/h) capacity or units (monthly)
aCNCNDDSGM.meaning: Monthly production of industrial boilers by enterprises above designated size in Shaanxi Province, the first of two Shaanxi series. Published by NBS Shaanxi Bureau monthly, typically in the second or third week of the following month. Shaanxi is China's third-largest coal-producing province and has major coal chemical, petroleum (Yanchang Petroleum, PetroChina Changqing), and emerging high-tech industries (Xi'an) that drive boiler demand.
aCNCNDDSGM.how_to_use: Shaanxi boiler production closely tracks the province's coal chemical complex activity — coal-to-methanol, coal-to-olefins, and coal-to-SNG plants require large-scale high-pressure boilers. YoY growth above 15% often accompanies new coal chemical plant commissioning cycles. Xi'an's growing semiconductor and aerospace industries (Aviation Industry Corporation) add a high-tech dimension to boiler demand. Monitor alongside Shaanxi coal output and coal chemical capex data.

aCNCNZAIIM.subcategory: Industrial Boiler Production — Shaanxi Province (Series B)
aCNCNZAIIM.units: tonnes of steam per hour (t/h) capacity or units (monthly)
aCNCNZAIIM.meaning: Monthly production of industrial boilers by enterprises above designated size in Shaanxi Province — the second of two Shaanxi series. Published by NBS Shaanxi Bureau monthly. Paired with aCNCNDDSGM to provide complete coverage of Shaanxi's boiler manufacturing sector.
aCNCNZAIIM.how_to_use: Combine with aCNCNDDSGM for a full Shaanxi boiler production view. Shaanxi is a key province for China's energy security strategy — Yan'an oilfield, Yulin coal chemical base, and Xi'an aerospace/defense manufacturing all require different boiler specifications. When the two series diverge, it may reflect shifts between coal chemical (high-pressure) and industrial process (medium-pressure) boiler mix within the provincial output.

aCNCNYMCM.description: Industrial boiler production, Shandong Province, Current Period, Year on Year Growth
aCNCNYMCM.subcategory: Industrial Boiler Production — Shandong Province, YoY Growth Current Period
aCNCNYMCM.meaning: Current-period year-on-year growth rate of industrial boiler production by enterprises above designated size in Shandong Province. Published by NBS Shandong Bureau monthly, typically in the second or third week of the following month. Shandong is China's second-largest industrial province (GDP >CNY 8 trillion) with massive petrochemical (Sinopec Shandong, Dongying private refinery cluster), chemical fiber, and paper industries driving boiler demand.
aCNCNYMCM.how_to_use: Shandong's boiler production YoY growth is among the most economically significant provincial series given the province's industrial scale. Growth above 10% often reflects active petrochemical complex expansions or paper sector capex. Shandong has aggressively pursued industrial boiler coal-to-gas switching, so growth can be positive even in an energy transition context (new gas boilers replacing old coal ones). Key risk: Shandong's private refinery sector (地炼) is opaque and can distort readings when under regulatory pressure.

aCNCNZFCCM.subcategory: Industrial Boiler Production — Shanxi Province (Series A)
aCNCNZFCCM.units: tonnes of steam per hour (t/h) capacity or units (monthly)
aCNCNZFCCM.meaning: Monthly production of industrial boilers by enterprises above designated size in Shanxi Province, the first of two Shanxi series. Published by NBS Shanxi Bureau monthly, typically in the second or third week of the following month. Shanxi is China's largest coal-producing province (~1.3 billion tonnes/year) with coking coal, coal chemical, and power generation sectors driving massive boiler demand.
aCNCNZFCCM.how_to_use: Shanxi boiler production is a direct proxy for coal sector activity — the province's boiler market is dominated by coal mine auxiliary boilers and coal chemical process boilers. A production surge of 20%+ YoY often coincides with coal price cycles (high prices incentivize mine expansion capex). Shanxi's SOE restructuring (State-owned coal giants: Coking Coal Group, Datong Coal) also affects boiler procurement cycles. Critical for energy market analysts monitoring Chinese coal supply-side capacity.

aCNCNBMGIM.subcategory: Industrial Boiler Production — Shanxi Province (Series B)
aCNCNBMGIM.units: tonnes of steam per hour (t/h) capacity or units (monthly)
aCNCNBMGIM.meaning: Monthly production of industrial boilers by enterprises above designated size in Shanxi Province — the second of two Shanxi series. Published by NBS Shanxi Bureau monthly. Paired with aCNCNZFCCM to provide complementary measurement perspectives on Shanxi's critical boiler manufacturing sector.
aCNCNBMGIM.how_to_use: Combine with aCNCNZFCCM for full Shanxi boiler output analysis. Given Shanxi's unique role as China's coal heartland, divergence between the two series may reflect the split between coal mine process boilers (small/medium scale) and large industrial boilers for coal chemical plants (high pressure, >400 t/h capacity). The shift in Shanxi's energy policy toward coal chemical upgrading (high-value chemicals vs. raw coal export) structurally increases demand for large high-specification boilers.

aCNCNKNBRM.subcategory: Industrial Boiler Production — Tianjin Municipality (Series A)
aCNCNKNBRM.units: tonnes of steam per hour (t/h) capacity or units (monthly)
aCNCNKNBRM.meaning: Monthly production of industrial boilers by enterprises above designated size in Tianjin Municipality, the first of two Tianjin series. Published by NBS Tianjin Bureau monthly, typically in the second or third week of the following month. Tianjin is a major industrial port municipality with petrochemical (CNOOC Bohai Chemical, Sinopec Tianjin), steel (Tianjin Steel), and manufacturing (Toyota, Airbus A320 final assembly) industries.
aCNCNKNBRM.how_to_use: Tianjin boiler output reflects the city's dual role as an industrial port and manufacturing hub. The Binhai New Area petrochemical complex drives the largest boiler demand segment. Tianjin's 2015 port explosion severely impacted industrial investment; the subsequent rebuild created a temporary but large procurement spike in 2016-17. Currently, Tianjin's industrial sector faces structural headwinds as SOE reforms continue — persistent output below 2018 peaks reflects this transition.

aCNCNARTFM.subcategory: Industrial Boiler Production — Tianjin Municipality (Series B)
aCNCNARTFM.units: tonnes of steam per hour (t/h) capacity or units (monthly)
aCNCNARTFM.meaning: Monthly production of industrial boilers by enterprises above designated size in Tianjin Municipality — the second of two Tianjin boiler series. Published by NBS Tianjin Bureau monthly. Paired with aCNCNKNBRM to provide comprehensive coverage of Tianjin's boiler manufacturing sector.
aCNCNARTFM.how_to_use: Use alongside aCNCNKNBRM to distinguish between Tianjin's product-type or period-aggregation variations in boiler production. Tianjin's strategic location — connecting Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei (Jing-Jin-Ji) economic zone with the Bohai port — means boiler production here serves both regional demand and export orders. Monitor alongside Beijing boiler series (aCNCNAMGMM) for Jing-Jin-Ji integrated regional industrial demand trends.

aCNCNTHFWM.description: Industrial boiler production, Xinjiang Uyghur Autonomous Region, Cumulative, Year on Year Growth
aCNCNTHFWM.subcategory: Industrial Boiler Production — Xinjiang, YoY Growth Cumulative
aCNCNTHFWM.meaning: Cumulative year-on-year growth rate of industrial boiler production by enterprises above designated size in Xinjiang Uyghur Autonomous Region. Published by NBS Xinjiang Bureau monthly, typically in the second or third week of the following month. Xinjiang is China's fastest-growing industrial frontier, with massive coal chemical, petroleum (Tarim Basin, Karamay oilfield), and new energy (solar, wind) infrastructure under development.
aCNCNTHFWM.how_to_use: Xinjiang cumulative boiler output growth is often the highest-YoY reading among Chinese provinces in periods of western development policy push — 20-40% cumulative growth is not uncommon during major infrastructure campaigns. The region's coal chemical ambitions (methanol, polyethylene, PVC from coal) require large-scale industrial boilers. Cross-reference with Xinjiang power generation capacity additions (National Energy Administration data) to link boiler output to energy infrastructure build-out pace.

aCNCNTLFJM.description: Industrial boiler production, Xinjiang Uyghur Autonomous Region, Current Period, Year on Year Growth
aCNCNTLFJM.subcategory: Industrial Boiler Production — Xinjiang, YoY Growth Current Period
aCNCNTLFJM.meaning: Current-period year-on-year growth rate of industrial boiler production by enterprises above designated size in Xinjiang Uyghur Autonomous Region. Published by NBS Xinjiang Bureau monthly. Unlike aCNCNTHFWM (cumulative), this series captures month-by-month momentum shifts without YTD smoothing.
aCNCNTLFJM.how_to_use: The current-period Xinjiang boiler series is highly volatile — seasonal effects, weather disruptions (extreme cold winter operations), and lumpy project procurement create ±50% monthly swings. Use the 3-month rolling average rather than single months for signal extraction. Persistent positive current-period readings (6+ consecutive positive months) confirm that Xinjiang industrial investment is sustained rather than a one-off project cycle. Key project to monitor: Xinjiang's '东数西算' (Eastern Data, Western Computing) data center buildout, which adds new process cooling/heating boiler demand.

aCNCNYXDIM.subcategory: Industrial Boiler Production — Zhejiang Province (Series A)
aCNCNYXDIM.units: tonnes of steam per hour (t/h) capacity or units (monthly)
aCNCNYXDIM.meaning: Monthly production of industrial boilers by enterprises above designated size in Zhejiang Province, the first of two Zhejiang series. Published by NBS Zhejiang Bureau monthly, typically in the second or third week of the following month. Zhejiang is a manufacturing powerhouse with chemical fiber (Hengli, Tongkun), petrochemical (Zhoushan, Ningbo), and light manufacturing industries — among the highest per-capita industrial boiler density provinces in China.
aCNCNYXDIM.how_to_use: Zhejiang boiler output is closely correlated with the chemical fiber and textile sector cycle — Zhejiang hosts ~60% of China's polyester filament production capacity (Hengli, Tongkun, Shenghong), which requires vast quantities of industrial steam. A YoY production increase above 10% in Zhejiang often signals a chemical fiber upcycle driven by apparel export orders. Cross-reference with polyester futures prices on ZCE and downstream apparel export data (MOFCOM) for signal validation.

aCNCNSQZPM.subcategory: Industrial Boiler Production — Zhejiang Province (Series B)
aCNCNSQZPM.units: tonnes of steam per hour (t/h) capacity or units (monthly)
aCNCNSQZPM.meaning: Monthly production of industrial boilers by enterprises above designated size in Zhejiang Province — the second of two Zhejiang series. Published by NBS Zhejiang Bureau monthly. Paired with aCNCNYXDIM to provide complete coverage of Zhejiang's boiler production.
aCNCNSQZPM.how_to_use: Combine with aCNCNYXDIM for a complete Zhejiang boiler picture. Zhejiang's environmental enforcement (Wenzhou, Taizhou, Hangzhou zones) has driven strong replacement demand for clean-energy boilers. The private-sector dominance of Zhejiang industry means boiler procurement is market-driven and faster-reacting to demand signals than state-sector dominated provinces like Shanxi or Liaoning. A leading indicator relationship with Zhejiang PMI (domestic business surveys) is typically reliable.

aCNCNXHWKQ.meaning: China industrial output: Industrial capacity utilization, automotive manufacturing. Industrial-sector production data for specific products or sub-sectors.
aCNCNXHWKQ.how_to_use: Track for sector-cycle dynamics. China is the world's largest producer of steel, cement, copper, aluminum, and many other industrial commodities. Sustained production declines signal industrial-sector deceleration; sustained increases reflect capacity expansion or commodity-cycle peaks.

aCNCNKWDNQ.description: Industrial capacity utilization, coal mining & washing industry
aCNCNKWDNQ.meaning: Quarterly industrial capacity utilisation rate for the coal mining and washing industry, published by the NBS as part of its quarterly industrial capacity survey. China's coal mining sector had chronic overcapacity through 2015; the 2016 'supply-side reform' (去产能) aimed to eliminate 800 Mt/year of capacity, pushing utilisation rates from ~65% toward ~80%. Current national coal capacity is ~5 billion tonnes/year.
aCNCNKWDNQ.how_to_use: Utilisation below 75% signals latent supply capacity that can be mobilised quickly during price spikes — a ceiling on coal price rallies. Above 85%, the coal market is supply-constrained and spot prices (Qinhuangdao 5,500 kcal thermal coal) will be supported. The series is released quarterly (March, June, September, December data), so use alongside monthly raw coal output (aCNCNKMHRM) as the intra-quarter proxy. A utilisation drop below 70% has historically preceded NBS announcements of further capacity rationalisation programs.

aCNCNJFEI.description: Industrial companies above designated size, accounts payable, state-owned metal products industry
aCNCNJFEI.meaning: Annual accounts payable balance at state-owned industrial enterprises above designated size in the metal products manufacturing industry, published by the NBS in its annual industrial enterprise financial statistics. Covers stamped/forged metal parts, metal structural components, metal containers, and hardware — all steel-downstream fabrication sub-sectors dominated by SOEs in defence, energy, and infrastructure applications.
aCNCNJFEI.how_to_use: Rising SOE metal-products payables without matching output or revenue growth signals balance sheet stress at state-owned fabricators — relevant for assessing systemic credit risk in the metals supply chain. Cross with aCNVANMETR (metal products sector value-added growth) to assess leverage ratios; payables growing faster than value-added typically precedes government-directed debt restructuring of SOE fabricators.

aCNCNMIGH.description: Industrial companies above designated size, accumulated depreciation of fixed assets, cigarette manufacturing
aCNCNMIGH.meaning: China Industrial: Industrial companies above designated size, accumulated depreciation of fixed assets, cigarette manufacturing. Industrial-sector aggregate or sub-aggregate.
aCNCNMIGH.how_to_use: Track alongside the broader industrial production data. Above-designated-size firms (>CNY 20M revenue) account for ~70% of industrial output.

aCNCNFEUX.description: Industrial companies above designated size, collective capital, artificial crude oil manufacturing
aCNCNFEUX.meaning: China Industrial: Industrial companies above designated size, collective capital, artificial crude oil manufacturing. Industrial-sector aggregate or sub-aggregate.
aCNCNFEUX.how_to_use: Track alongside the broader industrial production data. Above-designated-size firms (>CNY 20M revenue) account for ~70% of industrial output.

aCNCNOPAZ.description: Industrial companies above designated size, industrial sales value, coal mining & washing industry, Guizhou Province
aCNCNOPAZ.subcategory: Coal Industry Sales Value — Guizhou Province
aCNCNOPAZ.meaning: Industrial sales value for above-designated-size companies in the coal mining and washing industry in Guizhou Province, published irregularly by the NBS Guizhou Bureau. Guizhou (~140 Mt/year coal output) is one of China's major coal provinces, providing thermal coal to the Yangtze Delta and southwest power markets; recent mining accidents have led to periodic production curtailments.
aCNCNOPAZ.how_to_use: Irregular frequency limits systematic use; treat as periodic snapshots of Guizhou coal sector revenue health. Guizhou coal is structurally higher-cost than Shanxi or Inner Mongolia coal due to complex geology and mountainous terrain — when Guizhou coal sales values fall, it typically signals both lower prices and production disruptions rather than pure volume decline. Cross with aCNCNKMHRM (national raw coal) to assess Guizhou's market share trajectory.

aCNCNQSAJ.description: Industrial companies above designated size, industrial sales value, motor manufacturing
aCNCNQSAJ.meaning: China Industrial: Industrial companies above designated size, industrial sales value, motor manufacturing. Industrial-sector aggregate or sub-aggregate.
aCNCNQSAJ.how_to_use: Track alongside the broader industrial production data. Above-designated-size firms (>CNY 20M revenue) account for ~70% of industrial output.

aCNCNPKBN.description: Industrial companies above designated size, industrial sales value, off-highway recreational vehicles & spare parts manufacturing
aCNCNPKBN.meaning: China Industrial: Industrial companies above designated size, industrial sales value, off-highway recreational vehicles & spare parts manufacturing. Industrial-sector aggregate or sub-aggregate.
aCNCNPKBN.how_to_use: Track alongside the broader industrial production data. Above-designated-size firms (>CNY 20M revenue) account for ~70% of industrial output.

aCNCNTAIOM.description: Industrial companies above designated size, interest expense, automotive manufacturing, cumulative
aCNCNTAIOM.meaning: China Industrial: Industrial companies above designated size, interest expense, automotive manufacturing, cumulative. Industrial-sector aggregate or sub-aggregate.
aCNCNTAIOM.how_to_use: Track alongside the broader industrial production data. Above-designated-size firms (>CNY 20M revenue) account for ~70% of industrial output.

aCNCNNASKM.description: Industrial companies above designated size, interest expense, electricity, heat production & supply, year on year growth, cumulative
aCNCNNASKM.subcategory: Electricity, Heat Production & Supply — Interest Expense YoY Growth (Cumulative)
aCNCNNASKM.meaning: Cumulative year-on-year growth rate of interest expense for industrial companies above designated size in the electricity, heat production and supply sector. Published monthly by NBS, typically around the 27th of the following month. Captures the pace of debt-servicing cost accumulation in China's power generation and district heating complex amid interest rate cycles.
aCNCNNASKM.how_to_use: Interest expense growth above 8-10% YoY cumulative signals rising leverage pressure in the power sector — often coinciding with rapid renewable energy build-out (wind/solar farms are highly leveraged, 70-80% debt/total assets) or coal plant debt distress. Significant spikes (15%+ cumulative growth) can foreshadow credit stress at the five major state power groups and potential policy intervention via bond restructuring or equity capital injection. Compare with aCNCNJCERM for the broader utility complex.

aCNCNJCERM.description: Industrial companies above designated size, interest expense, electricity, heat, gas & water production & supply, year on year growth, cumulative
aCNCNJCERM.subcategory: Electricity, Heat, Gas & Water — Interest Expense YoY Growth (Cumulative)
aCNCNJCERM.meaning: Cumulative year-on-year growth rate of interest expense for industrial companies above designated size in the electricity, heat, gas and water production and supply sector. Published monthly by NBS, typically around the 27th of the following month. Broadens aCNCNNASKM by adding gas distribution and water supply entities — incorporates city gas operators (ENN, CR Gas, Kunlun Energy) and water utilities.
aCNCNJCERM.how_to_use: The broader utilities composite (electricity + gas + water) provides a more comprehensive leverage pressure indicator than the power-only series. Gas distribution companies in China typically carry CNY 30-100 billion in debt each; a cumulative interest expense growth above 12% YoY flags meaningful tightening in their financing conditions. This series is relevant for analysts covering China's infrastructure bond market and green bonds issued by state utility entities. Use alongside LPR and PBOC reserve requirement decisions for monetary policy transmission analysis.

aCNCNPHJNM.description: Industrial companies above designated size, interest expense, printing & recording media reproduction, year on year growth, cumulative
aCNCNPHJNM.subcategory: Printing Industry Interest Expense — YoY Cumulative
aCNCNPHJNM.meaning: Cumulative year-on-year growth rate of interest expense at industrial companies above designated size in the printing and recording media reproduction industry, published monthly by the NBS. Tracks financing cost trends for the printing sector, which consumes metallic inputs (tinplate for packaging, aluminum for printing plates) and is sensitive to broader industrial credit conditions.
aCNCNPHJNM.how_to_use: Primarily useful as a cross-sector credit cost benchmark — when printing-sector interest expense grows faster than manufacturing average, it signals broad corporate funding cost increases that will also affect metals fabricators. Compare with coal sector cost data (aCNCNDPCM) to assess whether cost pressures in both sectors are driven by common macro factors (PBoC rate cycles) versus sector-specific issues. Rising interest costs with flat output is a margin compression warning.

aCNCNFBSKM.description: Industrial companies above designated size, profit margin of main business, electricity, heat, gas & water production & supply
aCNCNFBSKM.subcategory: Electricity, Heat, Gas & Water — Profit Margin of Main Business
aCNCNFBSKM.meaning: Profit margin of main business (operating profit/revenue) for industrial companies above designated size in the electricity, heat, gas and water production and supply sector. Published monthly by NBS, typically around the 27th of the following month. This is the composite utility sector profitability gauge, aggregating power, gas, and water company financial performance.
aCNCNFBSKM.how_to_use: Utility sector profit margins below 3% signal systemic profitability stress — in regulated markets, margins are typically 4-6% in normal conditions. The 2021-22 energy cost spike pushed this below 2% for the electricity sub-sector, triggering the October 2021 market-based electricity pricing reform (allowable floating range widened to ±20%). A recovery above 5% indicates successful tariff reform pass-through or fuel cost relief. Key for pricing regulated-utility equity valuations and credit spreads on power sector bonds.

aCNCNQTYNM.description: Industrial ex-factory PPI, other electronic equipment manufacturing
aCNCNQTYNM.meaning: Industrial producer price index (ex-factory) for the 'other electronic equipment manufacturing' sub-sector, covering electronic components, circuit boards, display panels, sensors, and miscellaneous electronic devices not classified under computers, communications, or semiconductor ICs. Published monthly by NBS as part of the detailed PPI sub-index release, typically ~10th of the following month.
aCNCNQTYNM.how_to_use: A sustained above-100 reading (price increases) in this PPI sub-index reflects component cost inflation passing through the electronics supply chain — critical context for downstream consumer electronics assemblers' margins. Sharp deflation below 96 (as seen in 2023 display panel oversupply) signals inventory destocking pressure. Cross-reference with Taiwan's electronics export data and Korean DRAM/NAND spot prices for upstream confirmation of pricing trends. The relationship between this PPI and aCNCNVCOLM (profit margins) reveals pass-through efficiency.

aCNCNNFMEM.description: Industrial ex-factory PPI, other ferrous metal mining
aCNCNNFMEM.meaning: Monthly industrial ex-factory producer price index for 'other ferrous metal mining' — a sub-category covering iron ore not elsewhere classified, manganese ore, chromite, and other ferrous mineral extraction, published by the NBS. This is the upstream price signal for Chinese domestic iron ore mining, distinct from the seaborne iron ore benchmark (62% Fe CFR China).
aCNCNNFMEM.how_to_use: When this domestic ferrous mining PPI rises faster than imported iron ore prices (track via Platts 62% Fe CFR China), it signals domestic Chinese iron ore miners are gaining pricing power relative to overseas rivals — possible during periods of shipping disruption or import quota tightening. A PPI above 105 YoY for domestic ferrous mining historically coincides with increased capacity utilisation at inner Mongolia and Hebei iron ore mines.

aCNCNXIHMM.description: Industrial ex-factory PPI, other general equipment manufacturing
aCNCNXIHMM.meaning: Industrial producer price index (ex-factory) for the 'other general equipment manufacturing' sub-sector, covering pumps, valves, compressors, lifting equipment, air-handling equipment, and miscellaneous general-purpose industrial machinery not in specialized categories. Published monthly by NBS, typically ~10th of the following month.
aCNCNXIHMM.how_to_use: General equipment PPI is a mid-cycle indicator of industrial capex pricing pressure — when this index rises above 103-104, it signals tight capacity in equipment supply, often aligning with the 18-24 month lag from infrastructure FAI acceleration. Deflation below 98 (2015-16 episode) accompanied severe machinery overcapacity. Compressor and pump pricing in this index correlates with petrochemical project construction intensity. Compare with special equipment PPI and aCNPDMACC output growth to distinguish pricing-vs-volume dynamics in the machinery sector.

aCNCNFYFH.description: Industrial sales value, state-owned industrial companies above designated size, electricity production
aCNCNFYFH.subcategory: State-Owned Industrial Firms — Electricity Production Sales Value
aCNCNFYFH.meaning: Industrial sales value for state-owned industrial companies above designated size in the electricity production sector. Published by NBS as part of Industrial Enterprise Financial Statistics; frequency is irregular given the blank field. Captures total revenue from electricity sales by state-owned power generators (the five major power groups: Huaneng, Datang, CHN Energy, Guodian/now merged, Huadian), which dominate thermal and hydropower generation.
aCNCNFYFH.how_to_use: The state-owned share of electricity sales revenue reveals grid tariff dynamics and SOE electricity pricing power. Cross-reference with total electricity sector revenue (aCNCNFBSKM basis) to derive the SOE market share trend — typically 60-70% of total electricity production revenue. A declining state SOE share alongside rising private/renewable generator revenue signals the gradual market liberalization of the power sector (green power trading, provincial spot markets). Useful for credit analysis of SOE bonds.

aCNCNMSPQQ.meaning: Quarterly inventory level of integrated circuits (ICs) held by industrial enterprises above designated size in China. Published quarterly by NBS as part of the Industrial Production Statistics. IC inventory captures the balance between domestic chip production (including imported wafers processed domestically) and shipments to end-use customers in electronics, automotive, and industrial sectors.
aCNCNMSPQQ.how_to_use: IC inventory is a critical semiconductor cycle indicator for China — normal healthy inventory is roughly 45-60 days of supply. Inventory above 90 days signals oversupply/destocking pressure (as in 2022-23 when consumer electronics demand collapsed post-COVID stockpiling). Inventory below 30 days signals tight supply and potential production acceleration. Cross-reference with aCNCNCSINC (IC production) and aCNCNPTEQCEC (electronics output) to distinguish demand vs. supply-side inventory dynamics. A leading indicator for SMIC and Hua Hong Semiconductor earnings guidance.

aCNCNTZWTQ.meaning: Quarterly iron ore raw (run-of-mine) ore inventory at Chinese mines and processing facilities, published by the NBS as part of its quarterly industrial stock survey. Raw ore stocks at mine level differ from the more widely-tracked port stocks (Mysteel/SteelHome ~150 Mt at major ports) — these are upstream at the extraction point before beneficiation and pelletising.
aCNCNTZWTQ.how_to_use: High raw ore inventory at mines combined with falling port stocks implies domestic supply is available but logistics/processing capacity is the bottleneck — typically bullish for seaborne imports as mills draw down port inventory while domestic ore queues up. A raw ore inventory above 300 Mt at mines with port stocks below 100 Mt has historically preceded a seaborne iron ore price spike of $10-15/t within 6-8 weeks.

aCNCNTHCWM.description: Metal cutting machine tool output, Hubei Province
aCNCNTHCWM.subcategory: Metal Cutting Machine Tool Output — Hubei
aCNCNTHCWM.meaning: Monthly production of metal cutting machine tools (lathes, milling machines, boring machines, grinding machines) in Hubei Province, published by the NBS Hubei Bureau. Hubei is a significant machine tool producer, home to Wuhan Heavy Industry and Hanjiang Machine Tool. Metal cutting tools are both consumers of specialty steels and precision casting and indicators of manufacturing sector capital investment.
aCNCNTHCWM.how_to_use: Machine tool output is a capital investment leading indicator — when Hubei metal-cutting tools rise >10% YoY, it signals manufacturing sector capacity expansion in the Wuhan auto and equipment manufacturing cluster (Dongfeng Motor, CRRC Wuhan). Cross with aCNCNHAFYM (casting machinery) and aCNCNPGIUM (cast steel): rising machine tool output concurrent with rising cast steel suggests a broad capital goods investment cycle rather than just a single sector upturn.

aCNCNRQVC.description: New production capacity, solar power equipment installed
aCNCNRQVC.subcategory: Solar Power Equipment — New Production Capacity Installed
aCNCNRQVC.meaning: New production capacity of solar power equipment installed in China, capturing additions to photovoltaic panel, inverter, and solar mounting systems manufacturing capacity. Published by NBS or MIIT on an irregular/annual basis. China accounts for approximately 80% of global PV module production capacity, with major manufacturers including LONGi, Tongwei, JA Solar, and Trina Solar based in Jiangsu, Sichuan, Anhui, and Jiangxi.
aCNCNRQVC.how_to_use: Use to track the pace of China's solar manufacturing capacity expansion — new production capacity additions above 50 GW/year signal accelerating supply build-out that risks near-term oversupply and module price decline (exactly what occurred in 2023-24, with module prices falling below USD 0.15/W). This series is a leading indicator of global solar panel price trends — about 18-24 months ahead of module price deflation signals reaching Western markets. Essential for commoditized solar module margin forecasting.

aCNCNREZD.meaning: Nickel (refined nickel and nickel pig iron, NPI) production in China, published by the NBS with irregular/unspecified frequency. China is the world's largest nickel consumer (~60% of global demand) and a major NPI producer; NPI (low-grade nickel produced from Indonesian/Philippine laterite ore in Chinese RKEF furnaces) accounts for ~35% of China's nickel units, primarily for stainless steel. Refined nickel output (~200 kt/year) is mainly from Jinchuan Group.
aCNCNREZD.how_to_use: Track alongside Zhejiang steel (aCNCNZLVXM — Qingshan's stainless hub) to understand China's NPI-to-stainless vertically integrated supply chain. When NPI production rises >8% YoY, it typically implies a stainless steel supply surge within 4-8 weeks, which historically puts downward pressure on global stainless prices. The switch from NPI to battery-grade nickel sulfate (for EV batteries) is the structural theme — rising refined nickel alongside flat NPI signals this transition is accelerating.

aCNCNYXIIM.subcategory: Electricity, Heat Production & Supply — Loss-Making Units YoY Growth
aCNCNYXIIM.meaning: Year-on-year growth rate (end-of-period) in the number of loss-making enterprises above designated size in the electricity and heat production and supply sector. Published monthly by NBS as part of Industrial Enterprise Financial Statistics, typically around the 27th of the following month. A rising count of loss-making power firms signals broad sector financial distress.
aCNCNYXIIM.how_to_use: Loss-making unit count growth above 20% YoY is a systemic risk indicator for China's power sector — the 2021 coal-price spike episode saw over 40% of thermal power plants operating at a loss simultaneously. This series leads policy intervention by 2-3 months: surging loss-making unit counts typically trigger NDRC tariff adjustments or coal procurement price cap policies. Use alongside aCNCNFBSKM (profit margin) for a complete sectoral health assessment. Critical for China bond market analysts watching for power sector bailout signals.

aCNCNACLPM.description: Packaging special equipment output, Hebei ProvinceYear on Year Growth, Current Period
aCNCNACLPM.subcategory: Packaging Special Equipment Output — Hebei Province, YoY Growth Current Period
aCNCNACLPM.meaning: Current-period year-on-year growth rate of packaging special equipment output by enterprises above designated size in Hebei Province. Published by NBS Hebei Bureau monthly, typically in the second or third week of the following month. Packaging equipment (automated filling, sealing, labeling, and boxing machines) is a key sub-sector of special equipment manufacturing, driven by food/beverage, pharmaceutical, and consumer goods industries.
aCNCNACLPM.how_to_use: Hebei packaging equipment output growth correlates with downstream consumer goods manufacturing activity — positive YoY growth of 10%+ typically coincides with FMCG sector capacity expansions. Hebei's packaging equipment cluster is centered in Shijiazhuang and Tangshan, supplying both domestic manufacturers and export markets (packaging machinery is a high-growth export category). Cross-reference with aCNCNBFAM (special equipment costs) and China consumer goods retail data (NBS) for demand context.

aCNCNASQLQ.meaning: Quarterly pig iron inventory at Chinese steel mills and trading warehouses, published by the NBS as part of its quarterly industrial stock survey. Pig iron is the semi-finished product from blast furnaces (BF) before it is converted to crude steel in a basic oxygen furnace (BOF); typical BF-BOF cycle maintains 3-7 days of pig iron buffer stocks. China produces ~850 Mt/year of pig iron.
aCNCNASQLQ.how_to_use: Pig iron inventory above 15 Mt nationally signals blast furnaces are running ahead of BOF conversion demand — watch for mill-level production scheduling cuts and reduced iron ore purchase orders within 2-4 weeks. Below 8 Mt, the iron pipeline is lean and mills will need to accelerate BF production to avoid BOF downtime. This series should be read together with iron ore port stocks to assess the full upstream iron supply chain tightness/looseness.

Covers both automotive plant capital equipment and automotive instrument clusters.
aCNPDAUMOT.how_to_use: Automotive equipment output is a capex cycle indicator for China's car manufacturing industry — sustained growth of 15%+ YoY reflects auto OEM plant expansion or retooling (e.g., EV production line conversion). The motormeter sub-component correlates with vehicle instrument cluster demand, which tracks vehicle production directly. Compare with China's vehicle production (CAAM monthly data, typically 2-3 million units/month) and aCNCNDWGHM for internal consistency. EV transition creates upgrades from analog to digital instrument clusters.

aCNVAIINVR.description: Production, By Ownership, Value added, foreign, Hong Kong, Macau, Taiwan funded enterprises, growth rate, Chg Y/Y
aCNVAIINVR.meaning: Monthly year-on-year growth rate of industrial value-added at foreign, Hong Kong, Macau, and Taiwan-funded enterprises in China, published by the NBS as part of the monthly industrial output report. This series (Series A) captures the production contribution of FDI-linked manufacturing firms, which tend to concentrate in export-oriented electronics, auto, and precision manufacturing — sectors intensive in copper, aluminum, and specialty steel.
aCNVAIINVR.how_to_use: When foreign-funded industrial value-added decelerates below 3% YoY, it typically precedes a decline in China's export-linked metals demand — particularly copper for electronics, aluminum for auto/consumer goods, and cold-rolled steel for appliances. The FDI segment's growth rate diverging from the state-owned segment (compare with aCNVAIINVR and broader aCNVADMIN) provides insight into whether China's industrial slowdown is concentrated in export or domestic sectors.

aCNVAINVRR.description: Production, By Ownership, Value added, foreign, Hong Kong, Macau, Taiwan funded enterprises, growth rate, Chg Y/Y
aCNVAINVRR.meaning: Monthly year-on-year growth rate of industrial value-added at foreign, Hong Kong, Macau, and Taiwan-funded enterprises — a second NBS data series potentially reflecting revised methodology or a different vintage from aCNVAIINVR. Both series track the same FDI-linked industrial sector contribution to China's total industrial output.
aCNVAINVRR.how_to_use: Run alongside aCNVAIINVR as a dual-series quality control: when both trend in the same direction, the signal is reliable; persistent divergence suggests NBS methodology revision or scope change in the FDI enterprise sample. Use the FDI growth rate as a barometer for global MNC confidence in China manufacturing — when FDI industrial value-added contracts for three consecutive months (both series), it typically coincides with foreign auto/electronics OEM production cuts and signals near-term weakness in auto steel and copper demand.

aCNVAUMWSR.description: Production, Coal Mining, Washing and Dressing, Chg Y/Y
aCNVAUMWSR.subcategory: Coal Mining & Washing Value-Added Growth (Series A)
aCNVAUMWSR.meaning: Monthly year-on-year growth rate of industrial value-added in the coal mining and washing sector (Series A), published by the NBS as part of the monthly industrial production breakdown by sub-sector. This is one of the NBS's most-used sub-sector production growth indicators for China's coal industry, covering all above-designated-size coal mining and washing enterprises.
aCNVAUMWSR.how_to_use: A growth rate above +8% YoY typically indicates coal mines are running hot — often driven by energy security policy after supply shocks (post-2021 power crisis). Below -5% YoY signals broad production curtailment due to safety inspections, environmental restrictions, or price-driven closures of high-cost mines. Cross with capacity utilisation (aCNCNKWDNQ) to distinguish volume-driven vs efficiency-driven value-added changes. This series is released ~15th of the following month alongside the broader NBS industrial output report.

aCNVAMWSDR.description: Production, Coal Mining, Washing and Dressing, Chg Y/Y
aCNVAMWSDR.subcategory: Coal Mining & Washing Value-Added Growth (Series B)
aCNVAMWSDR.meaning: Monthly year-on-year growth rate of industrial value-added in the coal mining and washing sector (Series B) — second NBS series for the same sub-sector, potentially representing revised data, a different base-year deflator, or an alternative enterprise classification scope relative to aCNVAUMWSR. Both track the NBS industry code B06 (coal mining and dressing).
aCNVAMWSDR.how_to_use: Use alongside aCNVAUMWSR as a data quality cross-check; where both series agree, confidence in the signal is high. The two series are particularly useful during periods of NBS methodology revision (e.g., the 2019 industrial census-year rebasing), where divergence alerts analysts to potential backward revision risk. A sustained >2 ppt spread between Series A and B warrants caution in building regression models on coal sector activity.

aCNPDCSTEEL.meaning: Monthly production of coated steel sheet (galvanised, aluminised, colour-coated flat steel) in China, published by the NBS with irregular frequency. Coated steel sheet is a high-value flat product used in white goods (washing machines, refrigerators), HVAC ducting, automotive body panels, and roofing — end-markets where surface quality and corrosion resistance are premium requirements. China's coated sheet capacity is ~80 Mt/year.
aCNPDCSTEEL.how_to_use: Coated sheet production is a refined barometer of consumer durable and white goods demand — less volatile than construction-linked rebar. When coated sheet output rises alongside appliance production data (NBS consumer goods index), it confirms consumer sector recovery in China is broad-based. An unusual production surge alongside flat demand may indicate mills are converting commodity HRC to coated grades to improve margins — watch for SHFE coated steel spot premiums over HRC.

aCNPTEQCE.description: Production, Communications equipment, computers & other electronic equipment, Chg Y/Y
aCNPTEQCE.subcategory: Communications Equipment, Computers & Other Electronics — YoY Output Growth
aCNPTEQCE.meaning: Year-on-year growth rate of industrial output for the communications equipment, computers and other electronic equipment sector. Published monthly by NBS as part of the industrial production statistics (Industrial Value Added by Sub-Sector), typically released around the 15th of the following month. This aggregate covers smartphones, PCs, network equipment (Huawei, ZTE), and other consumer/commercial electronics.
aCNPTEQCE.how_to_use: One of the most market-watched Chinese industrial sub-sector output indicators. Growth above 10% YoY signals strong electronics super-cycle dynamics; contraction below -5% (as in Q4 2022) confirms consumer electronics demand collapse. Cross-reference with aCNPTEQCEC (which may represent a different aggregation vintage or revision) to confirm trend direction. Directly linked to Guangdong's GDP performance — the province contributes ~40% of this sector's output. A leading indicator for Apple supply chain manufacturers in Greater China.

aCNCCOMP.meaning: Monthly production of computers (including desktops, laptops, servers, and tablets) by industrial enterprises above designated size in China. Published monthly by NBS, typically released ~15th of the following month. China is the world's dominant computer manufacturer, with Lenovo, Dell, HP, and Apple production concentrated in Chongqing (notebooks), Suzhou (servers), and Guangdong (desktops/tablets). Production volume ~70-80 million units/year in normal periods.
aCNCCOMP.how_to_use: China computer production is a direct barometer of global PC and server demand — monitor in conjunction with IDC/Gartner quarterly shipment reports for consistency. Normal monthly output: 6-8 million units. A production decline below 5 million/month signals significant demand softness. Server production (data center AI buildout) has been the strongest sub-segment since 2023, driven by domestic AI investment. Cross-reference with aCNCNCSINC (IC production) for semiconductor input demand.

aCNPTEQCEC.description: Production, Computers, communications & other electronic equipment, Chg Y/Y
aCNPTEQCEC.subcategory: Computers, Communications & Other Electronic Equipment — YoY Output Growth (Alt)
aCNPTEQCEC.meaning: Year-on-year growth rate of industrial output for computers, communications and other electronic equipment — an alternative or updated series to aCNPTEQCE, potentially reflecting NBS classification revisions, seasonal adjustment differences, or scope changes as the Chinese standard industrial classification (GB/T 4754) evolved. Published monthly by NBS, typically released ~15th of the following month.
aCNPTEQCEC.how_to_use: Compare aCNPTEQCEC directly against aCNPTEQCE — consistent readings confirm data quality; persistent divergence signals a classification or base-year change that requires methodological investigation. In practice, use the more recently updated series as the primary indicator. Both series are critical for assessing whether China's electronics exports (aCNCEXBA) are supply-driven (output-led) or demand-driven (order-led) in a given quarter. The IT hardware export machine underpins ~$700 billion/year in Chinese exports.

aCNPDCRDS.meaning: Monthly crude steel production published by the NBS in the official monthly industrial output bulletin — the most authoritative headline steel figure covering all steelmaking methods (BOF, EAF, open-hearth) at above-designated-size enterprises. China typically reports 85-95 Mt/month; the NBS releases this data on or around the 15th of the following month.
aCNPDCRDS.how_to_use: This is the primary NBS crude steel series for supply modelling — distinguish from aCNCNCOSM (CISA key enterprises, released ~2 weeks earlier). A surprise above-consensus print of >2% vs Bloomberg survey median typically moves DCE iron ore futures by $3-8/t on the day of release. Annual production flirting with 1,050 Mt historically triggers Beijing steel output cap policy discussions, creating asymmetric downside risk for iron ore when national output approaches that threshold.
